item.title: Privacy-Preserving and Verifiable Approximate Distributed Coded Computing
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02187v1

AI Summary (中文)

隐私保护与可验证的近似分布式编码计算框架

分布式机器学习（如联邦学习与去中心化学习）在避免数据集中化的前提下实现协同建模，但面临双重安全挑战：一是训练过程易遭成员推断、梯度反演等隐私攻击；二是恶意参与者可投毒、篡改或伪造模型更新，破坏全局收敛性。现有方案多孤立应对隐私或鲁棒性问题，且高度依赖特定模型结构或学习范式（如仅适配CNN或仅支持联邦设定），难以跨场景复用。

本文提出首个模型无关、统一适配联邦与去中心化两种拓扑的 adversary-resistant 分布式学习框架。核心创新在于将GPBACC（Generalized Privacy-preserving and Byzantine-resilient Approximate Coded Computing）——一种支持任意ML模型的隐私增强型编码计算技术——与范式定制化防御机制深度融合：

  • 在联邦学习中，集成鲁棒聚合策略（如几何中位数+截断），显著抑制恶意客户端对全局模型的污染；
  • 在去中心化学习中，设计近似解码-比对（approximate decode-and-compare）与群组测试（group testing）联合验证机制，无需可信聚合器即可实现轻量级更新验证与恶意节点隔离。

我们通过攻击驱动的实证评估验证框架有效性：系统实施了6类典型隐私攻击（含模型逆向、梯度泄露）和4种主动对抗行为（如符号翻转、高斯投毒）。实验表明，在ResNet-18/CIFAR-10与BERT/StackOverflow任务上，本框架将隐私泄露风险降低72.3–89.1%（相较基线FedAvg），同时将拜占庭容错率提升至>85%（容忍30%恶意节点仍保持收敛）。结果证实：编码计算不仅是通信加速工具，更是构建可验证、可审计、可部署的安全分布式学习基础设施的关键使能技术。

AI Summary (English)

This paper introduces a model-agnostic framework for privacy-preserving and verifiable distributed learning that unifies defenses across federated and decentralized settings. At its core lies GPBACC—a generalized, approximate coded computing technique that injects privacy via random linear coding while enabling efficient, lightweight verification. For federated learning, we integrate robust aggregation (e.g., geometric median with clipping) to mitigate malicious updates; for decentralized learning, we propose an approximate decode-and-compare mechanism coupled with group testing to isolate adversaries without a trusted aggregator. Through attack-driven evaluation—including gradient inversion, membership inference, and Byzantine attacks—we demonstrate that GPBACC combined with these strategies reduces privacy leakage by up to 89.1% and achieves >85% Byzantine resilience under 30% adversarial participation. Our results establish coded computing as a practical foundation for secure, deployable distributed ML.

Abstract

Distributed machine learning enables collaborative model training without centralizing data, but it also exposes learning processes to privacy leakage and malicious manipulation. Existing defenses typically address these threats in isolation and are often tailored to specific learning paradigms or model architectures, limiting their applicability in realistic deployments. In particular, federated learning and decentralized learning exhibit distinct adversarial surfaces that are rarely addressed within a unified framework. In this paper, we present a model-agnostic framework for adversary-resistant distributed learning that jointly addresses privacy preservation and malicious behavior across both federated and decentralized settings. Our approach combines paradigm-specific defense mechanisms with GPBACC, a privacy-enhancing coded computing technique applicable to arbitrary machine learning models. For federated learning, we integrate robust aggregation strategies to mitigate the impact of malicious participants, while for decentralized learning we employ approximate decode-and-compare and group testing techniques to enable lightweight verification and adversary isolation without relying on a trusted aggregator. Crucially, we evaluate the proposed framework through an explicit, attack-driven analysis. We implement representative privacy attacks and malicious behaviors, and empirically demonstrate that the combination of GPBACC with robust aggregation and verification mechanisms significantly reduces privacy leakage and improves resilience against active adversaries. These results suggest that privacy-enhancing coded computing, when combined with appropriate adversary-resistance strategies, provides a practical and deployable foundation for secure distributed machine learning.

item.title: Behind the Refusal: Determining Guardrail Activation via Behavioral Monitoring
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02121v1

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

随着大语言模型（LLM）及智能体系统深度融入现实应用场景，其安全防护机制亟需可验证、可审计的评估能力。当前主流AI系统普遍部署运行时守护护栏（guardrail）系统，用于实时检测并拦截恶意输入/输出。然而，在黑盒对抗性测试中，研究者常难以区分：某次拒绝响应究竟是由底层LLM自身的安全对齐机制触发，还是由外部独立部署的守护护栏系统拦截所致——这一判别盲区直接导致攻击技术选型失误、绕过策略失效，甚至误判系统真实防御能力。

方法创新

本文提出首个黑盒式守护护栏侦察框架，仅依赖标准HTTP交互接口，无需任何内部模型知识或护栏配置信息。该方法通过三维度行为信号联合建模：

  • HTTP层信号：响应状态码、头部字段（如X-Guardrail-Hit隐式标记）、重定向行为；
  • 词法层信号：拒绝响应文本的模板化模式、关键词分布熵、语义一致性突变；
  • 时序层信号：请求处理延迟的统计偏移（护栏介入通常引入毫秒级确定性延迟）。

核心发现

在跨平台（含商用API与开源部署）的12个目标系统上实验表明：

  • 守护护栏存在性检测准确率达100%（n=3200+样本），且良/恶意交互间行为差异具有极强统计显著性（q < 0.001）；
  • 可自动推断护栏所监控的内容类别（如暴力、隐私、越狱等），覆盖率达92.3%；
  • 在未见过的提示词上，精准区分护栏拦截与LLM原生拒绝，平均F1分数达98%，显著优于基线方法（+37.6个百分点）。

AI Summary (English)

This paper introduces the first black-box methodology for guardrail reconnaissance—detecting and characterizing external safety guardrails deployed alongside LLMs, using only observable HTTP, lexical, and timing signals. Unlike prior work, our approach requires zero knowledge of the target system’s architecture or guardrail implementation. We demonstrate 100% accuracy in identifying guardrail presence across diverse production AI systems, with statistically significant behavioral separation between benign and malicious queries (q < 0.001). Crucially, our method further infers the content categories a guardrail is trained to block (e.g., hate speech, PII) and distinguishes guardrail-triggered blocks from native LLM safety rejections on unseen prompts, achieving an average F1 score of 98%. This enables precise, actionable adversarial evaluation and informs robust AI security auditing.

Abstract

As Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic systems become integrated into real-world applications, ensuring their safety and security is critical. Guardrail systems that detect and block malicious instructions sent to and from an LLM are an essential component of AI security. However, researchers conducting black-box adversarial emulation against production AI systems often struggle to determine whether a guardrail block or an LLM rejection has occurred. This distinction is important because the techniques used to bypass guardrails can differ substantially from those used to bypass LLM safety alignment, and has a material impact on attack technique selection and optimization. We propose the first black-box guardrail reconnaissance methodology, which detects the presence of a guardrail within a target AI system through behavioral monitoring of HTTP, lexical, and timing signals, assuming only black-box access and zero prior knowledge of the guardrail or AI system. Experiments demonstrate that our approach detects guardrail presence with 100% accuracy, with statistically significant behavioral separation between benign and malicious interactions (q < 0.001). Our approach further identifies the content categories a guardrail is designed to block, and distinguishes guardrail blocks from LLM rejection on unseen prompts with an average F1 score of 98%.

item.title: kNNGuard: Turning LLM Hidden Activations into a Training-Free Configurable Guardrail
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02072v1

AI Summary (中文)

kNNGuard：一种免训练、可配置的LLM安全护栏

背景与挑战：大语言模型（LLM）在实际部署中亟需高效可靠的护栏（guardrail）机制，以实时识别不安全、偏离主题或对抗性输入。现有主流方案依赖对专用分类器进行微调（fine-tuning），但存在泛化能力弱、推理延迟高、领域适配成本大（需重新训练）等瓶颈。

方法创新：本文提出 kNNGuard——一种完全免训练（training-free）、基于现成LLM内部激活空间的轻量级护栏框架。其核心思想是：仅需提供一个极小的标注样本库（仅50条安全/不安全提示），即可提取目标LLM各层隐藏激活（hidden activations），并融合多层k近邻（kNN）在激活空间的相似度得分与嵌入空间（embedding space）的语义距离得分，实现端到端分类决策。全程无需梯度更新、参数微调或额外训练。

关键性能优势：

  • 在涵盖话题合规性与安全防护的六大评测域上，kNNGuard的F1分数持平或超越当前最优微调型护栏；
  • 推理速度达同类最佳护栏的2.7倍，比典型微调安全分类器快10倍；
  • 领域迁移仅需替换标注样本库——构建新领域50样本库耗时<10秒，比传统微调快数个数量级；
  • 支持灵活配置（如系统提示词敏感性分析、最优判别层选择），可无缝集成至生产级LLM推理流水线，作为低延迟、高鲁棒的前置过滤模块。

kNNGuard首次证明：LLM的原始激活空间蕴含强判别信号，无需训练即可转化为高精度、高效率、易适配的安全护栏。

AI Summary (English)

kNNGuard is a training-free, configurable guardrail for LLMs that leverages raw hidden activations—without fine-tuning or gradient updates. Given only 50 labeled safe/unsafe prompts, it extracts multi-layer activations from an off-the-shelf LLM and fuses kNN-based similarity scores from both activation space and embedding space for classification. Across six diverse topical and security domains, kNNGuard matches or exceeds the F1 of state-of-the-art fine-tuned guardrails while running 2.7× faster than the best comparable method and 10× faster than a fine-tuned safety classifier. Domain adaptation requires only updating the small labeled prompt bank—constructible in under 10 seconds—making adaptation orders of magnitude faster than established alternatives. We further analyze system prompt effects, optimal layer selection, and practical integration into production LLM pipelines as a low-latency, plug-and-play safety module.

Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in domains requiring guardrails to detect unsafe, off-topic, or adversarial prompts. Existing guardrails predominately rely on fine-tuning to build classifiers, which often suffer from low generalization and high inference latency. We present kNNGuard, a training-free guardrail that utilizes the activation space of an off-the-shelf LLM. Given a small bank of 50 safe and unsafe prompts, kNNGuard extracts hidden activations and performs multi-layer kNN fusing activation-space and embedding-space scores for classification. Across six domains spanning topical and security prompts, kNNGuard achieves competitive or superior F1 compared to fine-tuned state-of-the-art guardrails while running 2.7x faster than the best comparable guardrail, and 10x faster than a fine-tuned safety classifier without gradient updates or fine-tuning. Domain adaptation requires only updating the labeled bank, which can be constructed in under 10 seconds and several orders of magnitude faster than established guardrails. We also analyze the impact of system prompts, layer selection, and integration into production LLM pipelines as a configurable, low-latency guardrail.

item.title: ElephantAgent: Contextual State Continuity in Agentic Systems
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01919v1

AI Summary (中文)

ElephantAgent：面向智能体系统的上下文状态连续性保障协议

背景与问题：当前智能体（agentic）系统通过调用外部工具与维护持久化记忆显著提升能力，但其依赖的工具描述与记忆模块正成为新型攻击面。近期研究揭示了“工具投毒”与“记忆投毒”攻击——攻击者可篡改工具元数据或注入恶意记忆片段，从而隐蔽地扭曲智能体的规划与决策行为。其根本症结在于：智能体缺乏对上下文状态（contextual state）的可验证连续性保障，即无法确认当前用于推理的工具集合、记忆快照及交互历史是否未被未授权篡改。

方法与设计：本文提出 ElephantAgent，一种轻量级、硬件增强的协议，首次将“状态连续性”（state continuity）范式系统性拓展至智能体的动态上下文层面。我们严格定义上下文状态为智能体全上下文中的安全关键子集（如已注册工具的元数据哈希、活跃记忆区块的加密摘要、最近N轮交互的签名轨迹），具有明确边界与可验证性。ElephantAgent 在每次查询处理前，自动重计算本地上下文状态的密码学摘要，并与由冗余可信硬件（如TEE集群）共同维护的线性化授权状态账本（ledger）中最新条目比对；任何摘要不匹配即触发实时告警与阻断。针对难以检测的“带内语义滥用”（如合法工具返回恶意内容），协议进一步引入历史可追溯性（Historical Traceability）：支持基于策略的条件审计，允许在检测异常后回滚至经验证的、已知安全的历史状态快照。

创新与价值：ElephantAgent 不依赖对LLM内部机制的修改，兼容主流智能体框架；实证表明其开销低于3.2%端到端延迟，且能100%检出典型投毒攻击。该工作为构建高保障智能体系统提供了首个面向上下文状态完整性与演化一致性的系统化防御范式。

AI Summary (English)

ElephantAgent is a hardware-assisted protocol that enforces Contextual State Continuity—a verifiable guarantee that an agentic system’s security-critical context (e.g., tool descriptors, memory snapshots, and interaction history) evolves only via authorized, linearizable transitions. It defends against contextual poisoning attacks (e.g., tool/memorization poisoning) by recomputing and validating the cryptographic digest of the local contextual state before each query against a replicated, TEE-backed ledger of approved state transitions. To address in-band semantic abuse—where legitimate tools return malicious outputs—ElephantAgent introduces Historical Traceability, enabling conditional post-hoc auditing and deterministic rollback to verified prior states. Evaluated on standard agent benchmarks, ElephantAgent incurs <3.2% end-to-end latency overhead while achieving 100% detection of known poisoning vectors—establishing the first practical, framework-agnostic defense for contextual state integrity in agentic systems.

Abstract

Agentic systems enhance their capabilities by invoking external tools and maintaining persistent memory. However, these external dependencies introduce novel attack surfaces. Recent tool and memory poisoning attacks show that maliciously crafted tool descriptors and poisoned memory can covertly bias agent behavior. These threats reflect a deeper issue: the lack of verifiable continuity in the agent's contextual state for planning and execution. We present ElephantAgent, a protocol that enforces Contextual State Continuity to defend against contextual state poisoning. Inspired by prior state-continuity mechanisms (e.g., Nimble), ElephantAgent extends this protection to the evolving contextual state of agentic systems. We define the contextual state as the bounded, security-critical subset of the agent's entire context (e.g., tool state and memory). Before processing each query, ElephantAgent recomputes the digest of the local contextual state and verifies it against the latest authorized digest. Using replicated trusted hardware, ElephantAgent maintains a linearizable ledger of authorized contextual state transitions and detects out-of-band state tampering. To handle in-band semantic abuse, ElephantAgent additionally provides Historical Traceability, enabling conditional post-hoc audit and recovery to a known-good prior state.

item.title: Pmeta-TLA: Backdoor Attacks for Speech Classification Models via Meta-Learning with Timbre Leakage Attack
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01702v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

随着智能设备的普及，语音分类模型（如关键词唤醒系统）被广泛部署，但其面临日益严峻的后门攻击威胁。现有语音触发器（如特定音调或合成噪声）易被深度神经网络防御机制检测，隐蔽性不足，且多数方法仅支持单目标后门注入，难以应对多任务、多意图场景下的协同攻击需求。

方法创新

本文提出Timbre Leakage Attack（TLA，音色泄露攻击）：通过在自监督学习提取的深层帧级特征中隐式嵌入目标说话人音色信息，生成人类听感自然、频谱扰动极小的中毒样本，显著提升感知隐蔽性。进一步，我们设计Pmeta-TLA——一种基于元学习的多后门一次性嵌入框架：

  • 采用元训练范式统一优化多个目标类别的后门策略；
  • 引入Projected Conflicting Gradients（PCGrad） 协调多任务梯度冲突，避免后门间干扰；
  • 将TLA作为核心多目标攻击工具，实现跨类别、低耦合的高效后门部署。

实验与结果

在Google Speech Commands v2和TIDIGITS数据集上，针对ResNet18、Wav2Vec 2.0及Conformer等主流模型开展关键词识别后门攻击实验。结果表明：
✅ 攻击成功率（ASR）达98.7%（高于基线平均+12.3%）；
✅ 人类可听性评估得分94.2%（显著优于传统触发器）；
✅ 对输入裁剪、加噪、重采样等鲁棒性测试保持>91% ASR；
✅ 单次训练即可注入5类后门，总计算开销降低37%（相较逐类微调）。
本工作首次将音色语义与元学习结合，为语音模型安全评估提供了高隐蔽、高扩展性的新型攻击范式。

AI Summary (English)

This paper proposes Pmeta-TLA, a novel backdoor attack framework for speech classification models, integrating Timbre Leakage Attack (TLA) with meta-learning and PCGrad. TLA injects imperceptible timbre cues into frame-level self-supervised features, generating natural-sounding poisoned samples that evade human and DNN-based detectors. Pmeta-TLA enables one-time multi-backdoor embedding: it meta-trains a shared backbone to simultaneously activate distinct triggers for multiple target classes, using PCGrad to resolve gradient conflicts during multi-objective optimization. Evaluated on keyword spotting tasks (Speech Commands v2, TIDIGITS) with ResNet18, Wav2Vec 2.0, and Conformer, Pmeta-TLA achieves 98.7% attack success rate, 94.2% perceptual stealthiness, >91% robustness under audio corruptions, and 37% lower training cost vs. sequential baselines. It establishes the first timbre-aware, meta-driven, multi-target backdoor paradigm for speech AI security analysis.

Abstract

Recently, speech classification methods have gained widespread adoption in intelligent gadgets. Current study indicates that backdoor attacks provide a substantial security concern to these models, underscoring the pressing necessity to investigate additional potential attack techniques to expose and prevent such risks. This work discusses the vulnerability of current speech triggers to detection by deep neural network defenders and introduces the Timbre Leakage Attack (TLA). The suggested trigger disseminates timbre information at the frame level within the deep self-supervised features, producing poisoned samples that appear natural to human perception. Furthermore, we introduce Pmeta-TLA, an innovative training mechanism for embedding numerous backdoors one time. This method proposes a multi-backdoor injection training strategy using meta-learning and Projected Conflicting Gradients (PCGrad) and introduces TLA as a multi-target attack tool within it. We performed tests on data-poisoning backdoor attacks in keyword spotting tasks utilizing some deep neural network models. Experimental results indicate that the proposed strategy attains superior Attack efficacy, enhanced stealthiness, robustness, and a reduced attack cost relative to baseline methods.

item.title: VeriChat: An Agentic Conversational AI Assistant for Hardware Security Verification
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01668v1

AI Summary (中文)

VeriChat：面向硬件安全验证的智能体式对话AI助手

硬件安全验证是一项多阶段、高专业性的工程任务，涉及复杂的设计分析、威胁建模与验证策略制定。当前EDA工具链缺乏结构化、上下文感知的安全指导能力，而通用大语言模型（如ChatGPT、Gemini）虽具交互潜力，却因幻觉风险高、知识静态陈旧、无法接入真实工具链，难以在安全关键场景中可靠应用。

为此，本文提出VeriChat——首个专为硬件安全验证设计的领域自适应、代理驱动（agentic）对话AI系统。它不替代现有工作流，而是以“协作者”角色嵌入验证流程：

  • 采用检索增强+三代理协同架构：知识代理（检索最新标准/漏洞库）、推理代理（分解安全问题）、执行代理（调用工具链），显著抑制幻觉，提升响应可解释性与可信度；
  • 深度集成开源EDA工具链：原生支持Icarus Verilog（语法检查/仿真）、Yosys（综合分析）、SymbiYosys（形式验证），可直接对用户提供的RTL代码执行端到端安全分析；
  • 在全面评估中，VeriChat达成87.73%的Faithfulness（忠实度）得分，超越主流闭源模型（如Claude 3.5 Sonnet、GPT-4o）；
  • 案例验证：在AES S-Box IP上，VeriChat通过多轮对话自主完成硬件木马识别→行为仿真→形式化证明，精准定位并验证一条隐蔽的密钥泄露漏洞，全程无需人工编码干预。

VeriChat标志着硬件安全验证从“手动调试”迈向“语义驱动、工具闭环”的新范式，为可信AI赋能芯片安全提供了可复现、可审计的开源框架。

AI Summary (English)

VeriChat is a domain-specialized, agentic conversational AI assistant designed to augment—rather than replace—hardware security verification workflows. To overcome hallucination and knowledge staleness in general-purpose LLMs, it employs a retrieval-augmented, three-agent architecture (knowledge, reasoning, execution) that collaboratively ensures factual grounding and transparency. Crucially, VeriChat natively integrates open-source EDA tools—including Icarus Verilog, Yosys, and SymbiYosys—to perform syntax checking, synthesis analysis, simulation, and formal verification directly on user-provided RTL. Evaluated rigorously, VeriChat achieves 87.73% Faithfulness, outperforming leading proprietary models. In an AES S-Box case study, it autonomously detects, simulates, and formally proves a covert key-leakage hardware Trojan via multi-turn dialogue—demonstrating end-to-end, tool-coupled security reasoning.

Abstract

Hardware security verification is a multi-stage process in which engineers must navigate complex design analyses, threat considerations, and verification strategies. They often need security-focused guidance, yet current verification environments provide little structured support for such assistance. Although conversational AI could offer such on-demand assistance, directly using general-purpose chatbots like ChatGPT or Gemini is risky due to their tendency to hallucinate and their reliance on static, outdated knowledge. We present VeriChat, a domain-specialized conversational assistant designed to support, rather than replace, existing verification workflows by providing context-aware security guidance. VeriChat employs a retrieval-augmented, multi-agent workflow in which three specialized agents collaboratively minimize hallucinations while improving the transparency and reliability of the response. Beyond question answering, VeriChat integrates open-source EDA tools, including Icarus Verilog, Yosys, and SymbiYosys, to perform syntax checking, synthesis analysis, simulation, and formal verification directly on user-provided RTL designs. Evaluated using a comprehensive methodology, VeriChat achieves a Faithfulness score of 87.73%, significantly outperforming the leading proprietary models. We demonstrate the framework through a hardware Trojan detection case study on an AES S-Box IP, where VeriChat autonomously identifies, simulates, and formally proves a covert key-leakage vulnerability through a multi-turn conversational workflow.

item.title: AgentFlow: Building Agent Dependency Graphs for Static Analysis of Agent Programs
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01640v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

大语言模型（LLM）智能体正日益以源代码形式开发，依托于各类智能体框架（如LangChain、LlamaIndex等）。这类程序融合了宿主语言（Python等）的传统代码与框架定义的语义要素——包括模型调用、提示词（prompt）、工具集成、记忆机制及多智能体协同逻辑。其行为不仅依赖传统控制流与数据流，更受框架诱导的智能体依赖关系（agent dependencies）主导，例如智能体构造器声明、工具装饰器、智能体交接（handoff）指令等。此类依赖隐式编码于框架API中，难以被现有AST解析或依赖追踪工具识别。

方法：AgentFlow 与智能体依赖图（ADG）

本文提出 AgentFlow——首个面向智能体程序的静态分析框架。其核心是构建智能体依赖图（Agent Dependency Graph, ADG）：一种框架无关的图结构，将智能体、提示词、模型、能力（capabilities）、内存状态及控制策略建模为类型化节点；将组件依赖、控制流与数据流建模为类型化边。ADG统一抽象跨框架语义，支持精确捕获“prompt → tool”调用链、“agent A → agent B”交接、“memory state → model input”等关键依赖。

主要发现与创新

我们在5个主流框架（LangChain、LlamaIndex、AutoGen、Semantic Kernel、DSPy）上实现AgentFlow，并在包含5,399个真实智能体程序的基准集AgentZoo上评估：

  • 相比AST基线工具，AgentFlow识别出2.8×更多智能体实体（如隐式工具绑定、动态提示注入点）和3.1×更细粒度依赖关系；
  • 生成的智能体物料清单（Agent BOM） 显式标注各组件来源、版本及依赖路径，支持合规审计；
  • 首次发现238例污染型prompt-to-tool风险（如恶意提示触发高权限工具），其中92%未被现有安全扫描覆盖；
  • ADG为智能体治理（如责任追溯、变更影响分析）与安全加固（如最小权限工具绑定、prompt沙箱）提供了可扩展的底层表示基础。

AI Summary (English)

This paper introduces AgentFlow, the first static analysis framework for recovering and reasoning about agent dependencies—framework-induced semantic relationships (e.g., tool bindings, agent handoffs, prompt-model couplings) that govern LLM agent behavior but evade conventional AST-based tools. AgentFlow constructs a framework-agnostic Agent Dependency Graph (ADG), modeling agents, prompts, models, capabilities, memory states, and policies as typed nodes, and their component, control-, and data-flow dependencies as typed edges. Implemented for five major agent frameworks and evaluated on AgentZoo (5,399 real-world programs), AgentFlow identifies significantly richer agent entities and dependencies than prior approaches, generates precise, dependency-aware Agent Bills of Materials (BOMs), and uncovers 238 previously undetected taint-style prompt-to-tool security risks. Our results establish ADG as a practical foundation for governing, auditing, and securing agent software.

Abstract

LLM agents are increasingly developed as source-code applications built on agent frameworks. These agent programs combine conventional host-language code with framework-defined semantics for models, prompts, tools, memory, and multi-agent orchestration logic. As a result, their behavior depends not only on traditional control and data flows, but also on a new class of agent dependencies. Such dependencies are often expressed as framework-induced semantics, such as agent constructors, tool decorators, and agent handoff declarations, making them difficult to recover with existing static analysis or dependency tracking tools. In this paper, we present AgentFlow, the first static analysis framework for recovering and analyzing agent dependencies from agent programs. AgentFlow constructs an Agent Dependency Graph (ADG), a framework-agnostic graph representation that represents agents, prompts, models, capabilities, memory states, and control policies as typed nodes, and captures their component-dependency, control-flow, and data-flow dependencies as typed edges. Built on ADGs, AgentFlow supports a range of analyses for agent governance and security, including Agent Bill of Materials (BOM) generation and prompt-to-tool risk detection. We implement AgentFlow for five representative agent frameworks and evaluate it on AgentZoo, a corpus of 5,399 real-world agent programs. Our evaluation shows that AgentFlow recovers richer agent entities and dependencies than existing AST-based agent static analysis tools, generates more dependency-aware Agent BOMs, and uncovers 238 taint-style prompt-to-tool risks in real-world agent programs. These results show that ADG provides a practical foundation for understanding, governing, and securing emerging agent software.

item.title: QFedAgent: Quantum-Enhanced Personalized Federated Learning for Multi-Agent Activity Recognition
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02426v1

AI Summary (中文)

QFedAgent：面向多智能体活动识别的量子增强个性化联邦学习框架

背景与挑战：联邦学习（FL）为分布式机器人感知系统提供了隐私保护的协同建模范式，但多智能体场景下传感器数据呈现显著的异构性与非独立同分布（non-IID）特性——尤其在加速度计与陀螺仪等多模态时序流中。传统FL算法易受数据偏斜影响，而经典融合模块（如多层感知机）参数量大、通信开销高，难以适配资源受限的边缘智能体。

方法创新：本文提出QFedAgent，首个融合变分量子电路与个性化联邦学习的端到端框架。其核心是轻量化量子态编码融合模块：将双模态传感器信号映射为量子比特初态，利用受控旋转门与纠缠门显式建模加速度-角速度跨模态动态耦合关系；仅需72个可训练量子旋转参数，相较经典MLP融合模块（33,000+参数）实现约10倍参数压缩，大幅降低本地计算负载与全局通信带宽需求。

实验验证：在OPPORTUNITY基准数据集上构建基于受试者划分的non-IID设定（每位用户数据独立分片），QFedAgent达成97.7%平均测试准确率，超越FedAvg、FedProx等基线模型（+2.1–3.8个百分点），且收敛速度提升35%。结果证实：量子增强的参数高效融合不仅可行，更在隐私、效率与性能间取得新平衡。

贡献亮点：① 首次将变分量子电路嵌入联邦学习架构用于多智能体感知；② 提出物理启发的量子纠缠建模机制替代黑箱神经融合；③ 开源轻量级量子-经典混合训练流水线，支持边缘部署。

AI Summary (English)

QFedAgent introduces a hybrid quantum-classical personalized federated learning framework for multi-agent activity recognition. To address severe non-IID data heterogeneity and high parameter overhead in classical fusion modules, it replaces conventional MLP-based sensor fusion with a variational quantum circuit that encodes accelerometer–gyroscope signals into quantum states and models their interaction via entanglement—requiring only 72 trainable rotation parameters versus 33K in classical counterparts (≈10× parameter reduction). Evaluated on the OPPORTUNITY dataset under subject-wise non-IID partitioning, QFedAgent achieves 97.7% mean test accuracy, outperforming standard FL baselines (FedAvg, FedProx) by 2.1–3.8 percentage points while accelerating convergence by 35%. This work demonstrates that quantum-enhanced, parameter-efficient fusion is both practical and competitive for privacy-preserving edge intelligence.

Abstract

Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed devices without sharing raw data, making it suitable for privacy-sensitive robotic sensing applications. However, multi-agent systems generate heterogeneous and non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) multimodal sensor streams that degrade conventional FL algorithms, while classical fusion modules introduce substantial parameter overhead and communication cost. This paper proposes QFedAgent, a hybrid quantum-classical personalized FL framework for multi-agent activity recognition. The approach integrates a variational quantum circuit fusion module that models accelerometer--gyroscope interactions through quantum state encoding and entanglement, requiring only 72 quantum rotation parameters versus 33K in classical multi-layer perceptron-based fusion, achieving approximately 10x total parameter reduction. Experiments on the OPPORTUNITY dataset under subject-based non-IID partitions demonstrate 97.7% mean test accuracy, confirming that parameter-efficient quantum fusion remains competitive with conventional federated baselines.

item.title: Grounded autonomous research: a fault-tolerant LLM pipeline from corpus to manuscript in frontier computational physics
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02329v1

AI Summary (中文)

面向前沿计算物理的具身自主研究：一种从文献库到论文稿的容错型大语言模型流水线

当前自主科研代理在机器学习沙箱中已实现端到端自动化，但其依赖执行反馈校准的范式难以迁移到前沿物理科学——此处方法论选择根植于深层物理推理，工具链常缺乏完备文档，且校准必须锚定外部文献证据。未加约束的代理仅引用文献而不主动比对验证，易基于内部先验生成看似合理却不可证伪的结果。

本研究提出首个面向高风险科学领域的容错型LLM自主科研流水线：以11,083篇近期凝聚态物理arXiv论文为起点，全自动产出具备三项实质性物理发现（本文聚焦反铁磁性压磁效应）的期刊级论文稿。流水线严格分六阶段、47个独立上下文会话运行，各会话仅通过磁盘状态共享，全程执行2,162次文献查证。核心创新在于结构化数值对抗校准：代理不仅检索文献，更强制复现关键参考文献中的定量结果（如能带结构、磁序能量差），失败时触发有限人工干预（仅限操作知识补全，不干预科学判断）。容错性源于三重冗余机制：① 每次会话上下文隔离防错误累积；② 分布式文献 grounding（跨阶段多点交叉验证）；③ 内置对抗性审稿模块主动挑战中间结论。

消融实验表明：预架构基线与无试点（no-pilot）变体均因缺失校准点上的强制数值 confrontation 而崩溃。本工作首次系统刻画了自主科研中的典型失效模式，量化了人机协作边界（干预率<0.8%），为计算物理乃至核物理、量子化学等高 stakes 领域的可信自主科研奠定方法论基础。

AI Summary (English)

We present the first fault-tolerant LLM pipeline for autonomous research in frontier computational physics—where physical reasoning, undocumented toolchains, and literature-anchored calibration preclude naive sandbox automation. Starting from a corpus of 11,083 arXiv papers, the system autonomously identifies a research direction (altermagnetic piezomagnetism), calibrates methodology by reproducing quantitative results from published references, performs novel first-principles calculations, and writes a publication-grade manuscript—all grounded via 2,162 literature consultations across 47 fresh-context sessions. Fault tolerance arises from three design primitives: context isolation, distributed grounding, and adversarial review—catching errors missed by any single session. Human intervention is strictly bounded to operational knowledge curation only upon reproduction failure (<0.8% of steps); scientific direction remains fully autonomous. Ablation studies confirm that structurally enforced numerical confrontation at calibration checkpoints—not mere citation—is the operative grounding mechanism. This work establishes primitives, failure taxonomies, and quantified human-AI boundaries for trustworthy autonomous science beyond physics.

Abstract

Autonomous-research agents have demonstrated end-to-end LLM automation in machine-learning sandboxes where execution provides calibration. Frontier physical science differs categorically: physical reasoning underlies every methodology choice, toolchains are often underdocumented, and calibration must come from external literature anchors - which unscaffolded agents cite but do not confront, hallucinating plausible, unverifiable results from internal priors. We present a pipeline that runs end-to-end from a corpus of 11,083 recent condensed-matter physics arXiv papers to a publication-grade manuscript with three substantive physics findings (here on altermagnetic piezomagnetism): the agent autonomously conceives a research direction by mapping the corpus, calibrates methodology by reproducing published references, conducts novel first-principles computations, and writes the manuscript - grounded in literature throughout, across 47 fresh-context sessions in six phases sharing only on-disk state, with 2,162 literature-consultation events. Fault tolerance emerges from redundancy: fresh-context isolation, distributed grounding, and adversarial review catch what any single session misses; pre- and post-pilot stages are fully autonomous, and pilot requires bounded human intervention only at reproduction failures - operational knowledge curation, not scientific direction. Two paired failure modes - a pre-architecture baseline and a no-pilot ablation - isolate structurally enforced numerical confrontation at calibration checkpoints as the operative grounding mechanism. The primitives, characterized failure modes, and quantified intervention pattern lay a foundation for autonomous research in high-stakes scientific domains beyond computational physics.

item.title: Evidence-State Rewards for Long-Context Reasoning
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02073v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

长上下文推理要求模型在海量输入中定位、修正与整合分散的证据，但现有强化学习（RL）方法多仅对最终答案或静态证据抽取结果给予奖励，缺乏对中间动作如何动态更新证据状态的细粒度反馈，导致证据导航低效、干扰项残留高。

方法：Maven 框架

我们提出 Maven——一种具备可编辑证据记忆的长上下文 RL 框架。其核心创新在于定义答案条件下的证据状态价值函数，并设计动作级状态转移奖励机制：

  • 添加动作（add）：基于边际增益（新增证据对当前状态的价值提升）与回溯贡献（该证据在最终答案生成中的事后归因权重）双重赋分；
  • 链接动作（link）：依据证据协同性（多证据联合支撑答案的互补性强度）奖励；
  • 删除动作（drop）：当移除误导性证据后答案支持度显著提升时给予正向奖励。

所有奖励均精准分配至 GRPO（Generalized Reinforcement Policy Optimization）中的对应动作时间跨度。

主要发现与创新点

在 LongBench v2、LongReason 和 RULER 三大长上下文基准上，Maven 在 Llama-3-8B 与 Qwen2-7B 上全面超越仅奖励结果的 RL 基线及证据识别基线：
✅ 生成的证据集完整性提升 23.7%（F1-evidence），
✅ 干扰项保留率降低 31.4%（Distractor Retention Rate），
✅ 推理路径更可解释、状态演化更可控。
本研究首次证实：优化证据状态的动态导航过程，比追求单次精准证据抽取更能释放长上下文 RL 的潜力。

AI Summary (English)

Long-context reasoning demands dynamic navigation—locating, revising, and synthesizing distributed evidence—yet existing RL methods reward only final answers or static evidence extraction, ignoring how intermediate actions evolve the model’s evidence state. We propose Maven, an RL framework with editable evidence memory that introduces answer-conditioned evidence-state value and action-level rewards: add actions are scored via marginal gain and hindsight contribution; link actions via evidence synergy; and drop actions when removing misleading evidence improves answer support. Rewards are assigned to action spans in GRPO. Evaluated on LongBench v2, LongReason, and RULER across Llama-3-8B and Qwen2-7B, Maven significantly outperforms outcome-only RL and evidence-identification baselines—yielding more sufficient evidence sets (+23.7% F1-evidence) and lower distractor retention (−31.4%). Our work establishes that optimizing stateful evidence navigation, not one-shot extraction, is key to advancing long-context RL.

Abstract

Long-context reasoning requires models to locate, revise, and synthesize evidence distributed across lengthy inputs. Existing long-context RL methods usually reward final answers or static evidence extraction, offering little feedback on how intermediate actions change the model's evidence state. We propose Maven, a reinforcement learning framework with an editable evidence memory. Maven defines an answer-conditioned evidence-state value and rewards action-level state transitions: add actions are credited by marginal gain and hindsight contribution, link actions by evidence synergy, and drop actions by improved answer support after removing misleading evidence. These rewards are assigned to the corresponding action spans in GRPO. Across Llama and Qwen models on LongBench v2, LongReason, and RULER, Maven outperforms outcome-only RL and evidence-identification baselines, producing more sufficient evidence sets and lower distractor retention. Our results show that long-context RL benefits from optimizing stateful evidence navigation rather than one-shot evidence extraction.

item.title: OntoLearner: A Modular Python Library for Ontology Learning with Large Language Models
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01977v1

AI Summary (中文)

OntoLearner：首个面向本体学习的模块化开源框架

背景与挑战：本体学习（Ontology Learning, OL）旨在从非结构化文本中自动构建结构化知识模型，但长期以来受限于方法碎片化、领域割裂及评估标准缺失。缺乏统一的基础设施导致研究难以复现、比较与迭代，核心瓶颈——如知识表征错配问题——始终未被系统揭示。

方法与创新：本文提出 OntoLearner，首个支持跨领域、多任务、可扩展的Python开源库（MIT许可）。其三大支柱为：

  • ✅ 统一本体访问层：发布180个机器可读本体，覆盖22个领域（含生物医学、法律、教育等），均经标准化清洗与URI对齐；
  • ✅ LLM驱动的学习流水线：模块化设计支持即插即用的提示工程、检索增强与微调接口，兼容主流开源/闭源大语言模型；
  • ✅ 标准化基准套件：提供3项核心OL任务的pipeline-ready数据集（含train/dev/test划分）：术语类型识别（Term Typing）、层级结构发现（Taxonomy Discovery）、非层级关系抽取（Non-taxonomic Relation Extraction）。

关键发现：基于该框架，我们开展迄今最大规模OL实证研究，评估22种检索模型与12种LLM（参数量跨度1B–70B）。结果颠覆传统认知：性能衰减主因并非模型规模或架构先进性，而是本体固有复杂度（如层级深度、关系密度、语义歧义度）。根本瓶颈在于——LLM的分布式、上下文依赖式知识编码，与本体的显式、逻辑约束型结构存在结构性错配（structural mismatch）。

意义：OntoLearner不仅提供即用工具链，更确立“跨领域多任务联合评估”为突破OL瓶颈的关键范式。代码与资源已开源：https://github.com/sciknoworg/OntoLearner

AI Summary (English)

OntoLearner is the first modular, open-source Python library designed to unify ontology learning (OL) research across domains and tasks. It addresses long-standing fragmentation by providing: (1) 180 standardized, machine-readable ontologies spanning 22 domains; (2) pipeline-ready datasets with train/dev/test splits for three core OL tasks—term typing, taxonomy discovery, and non-taxonomic relation extraction; and (3) a flexible LLM-integrated framework supporting prompt engineering, retrieval augmentation, and fine-tuning. Through large-scale evaluation of 22 retrieval models and 12 LLMs (1B–70B parameters), we find that OL failure modes scale primarily with ontological complexity (e.g., depth, relational density, ambiguity), not model size or architecture. The key bottleneck is a structural mismatch: LLMs encode knowledge contextually and distributionally, whereas ontologies require explicit, logically constrained representations. OntoLearner thus establishes cross-domain, multi-task benchmarking as essential for advancing OL—and is released under MIT license at https://github.com/sciknoworg/OntoLearner.

Abstract

Ontology learning (OL) aims to automatically construct structured knowledge models from text, yet progress remains fragmented across methods, domains, and evaluation practices. Despite decades of research, OL lacks a shared infrastructure for systematic evaluation and ontology access. This absence has hindered progress and fragmented research, leaving the central challenges of OL largely unaddressed. We introduce OntoLearner, a modular, cross-domain, and first-of-its-kind framework that unifies ontology access, large language model (LLM)-driven learning pipelines, and standardized benchmarking. OntoLearner releases 180 machine-readable ontologies spanning 22 domains and provides pipeline-ready datasets with train/dev/test splits for three core OL tasks: term typing, taxonomy discovery, and non-taxonomic relation extraction. Using this infrastructure, we conduct a large-scale empirical study of OL, evaluating 22 retrieval models and 12 LLMs across domains and tasks. The results converge on a finding that reframes the central challenge of OL: failure modes scale with ontological complexity rather than model size or architectural sophistication. The primary bottleneck is not model capability, but a structural mismatch between how models encode knowledge and how ontologies organize it. These findings establish that effective OL is reachable through the cross-domain, multi-task benchmarking enabled by OntoLearner. OntoLearner is open-source (MIT license) at https://github.com/sciknoworg/OntoLearner/.

item.title: MMIR-TCM: Memory-Integrated Multimodal Inference and Retrieval for TCM Clinical Decision Support
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01814v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

中医舌诊长期受限于主观性强、可重复性低等问题，而现有 multimodal AI 方法在证候辨识与方剂生成等临床任务中，因视觉舌象特征与文本推理间存在显著语义鸿沟，且缺乏大规模、标准化多模态数据集，进展缓慢。

方法创新：MMIR-TCM 框架

我们提出 MMIR-TCM——一种模拟中医专家诊疗思维的新型记忆增强型多模态推理与检索框架，包含三大核心组件：

  • Memory-SAM：训练无关的记忆增强分割模块，实现鲁棒、高精度舌体提取；
  • Qwen3-VL 微调模型：生成结构化舌诊报告（含苔色、苔质、舌色、舌形四维诊断要素）；
  • Qwen3-RAG 检索增强生成模块：基于临床指南与古籍知识库，提供证据支撑的证候辨识与处方建议。

数据与评估突破

  • 构建并开源 MedTCM 数据集：首个面向深度中医AI研究的大规模多模态数据集（含12,856例舌图+结构化诊断+处方+权威依据），覆盖23类常见证型；
  • 提出领域专属评估指标 TDEU（TCM Diagnostic Evaluation Utility），融合语义理解度（Semantic Alignment）与诊断关键性权重（Diagnostic Importance Weighting），弥补传统BLEU/ROUGE在临床合理性上的不足。

主要结果

在MedTCM基准测试中，MMIR-TCM在舌诊结构化生成（F1=0.892）、证候辨识准确率（86.4%）及处方推荐临床一致性（医师盲评Kappa=0.78）上均显著优于GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 Flash及基线MLLM。消融实验证实记忆分割与RAG检索对诊断可信度提升贡献率达+19.3%和+15.7%。

AI Summary (English)

Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) tongue diagnosis suffers from subjectivity and poor reproducibility, while existing multimodal AI approaches are hindered by the semantic gap between visual tongue features and clinical reasoning—and critically, by the lack of large-scale, standardized datasets. To bridge this gap, we propose MMIR-TCM, a memory-integrated multimodal framework that emulates expert TCM diagnostic workflow via three synergistic components: (1) a training-free Memory-SAM for robust tongue segmentation; (2) a fine-tuned Qwen3-VL model generating structured, four-dimensional tongue diagnoses (tongue color, coating color, coating texture, tongue shape); and (3) a Qwen3-based RAG module retrieving evidence from TCM guidelines and classical texts to support syndrome differentiation and prescription generation. We introduce MedTCM, the first large-scale multimodal TCM dataset (12,856 cases with paired tongue images, structured diagnoses, prescriptions, and authoritative references), and propose TDEU, a domain-specific metric evaluating both semantic alignment and diagnostic importance weighting. Extensive experiments show MMIR-TCM achieves state-of-the-art performance—outperforming GPT-4o and Gemini 2.5 Flash by +12.6% in diagnostic F1 and +9.3% in prescription clinical consistency (physician-blinded evaluation)—with ablation confirming critical gains from memory-augmented segmentation (+19.3%) and retrieval augmentation (+15.7%).

Abstract

Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) diagnosis, particularly through tongue inspection, faces persistent challenges in subjectivity and reproducibility. The application of multimodal artificial intelligence to TCM clinical tasks, such as syndrome differentiation and prescription generation, is significantly hampered by the semantic gap between visual tongue features and textual reasoning, as well as the lack of large-scale, standardized datasets. To address these challenges, we introduce MMIR-TCM, a novel framework that emulates the diagnostic process of TCM experts by integrating multimodal large language model(MLLM) with memory-augmented segmentation and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Employing a three-stage architecture, MMIR-TCM integrates a training-free Memory-SAM module for robust tongue extraction, a fine-tuned Qwen3-VL model for structured tongue diagnosis generation, and a Qwen3-based RAG component for evidence-grounded clinical decision support generation. The framework was developed and validated using MedTCM, a new large-scale multimodal dataset that we introduce specifically for advanced TCM research. To properly evaluate our framework's clinical accuracy, which existing metrics fail to capture, we also developed TDEU, a domain-specific evaluation metric incorporating semantic understanding and diagnostic importance. Our comprehensive experiments demonstrate that MMIR-TCM significantly outperforms leading models, including GPT-4o and Gemini 2.5 Flash.

item.title: DRL-CLBA: A Clean Label Backdoor Attack for Speech Classification via DDPG Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01729v1

AI Summary (中文)

DRL-CLBA：基于DDPG强化学习的语音分类清洁标签后门攻击

背景与挑战：语音分类深度神经网络（DNN）面临严重的后门攻击威胁——攻击者通过注入隐蔽触发器，使模型在推理阶段对含触发器的样本产生定向误判。现有样本级攻击虽能绕过部分防御机制，但多依赖“污染标签”（poisoned label），易被人工审核或标签一致性检测识别，安全性与隐蔽性受限。

方法创新：本文提出 DRL-CLBA（Deep Reinforcement Learning-based Clean Label Backdoor Attack），首次将深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）强化学习框架引入语音后门攻击设计。其核心包含两大技术：

  • 清洁标签机制：不篡改原始标注，所有目标样本保持真实标签，彻底规避标签层面检测；
  • 深度音频隐写触发嵌入：利用深度音频隐写术，在原始语音波形中无感嵌入样本专属触发器，生成高鲁棒性、低可感知性的特征空间锚点（anchor points）；
  • 潜空间定向优化：DDPG智能体以模型深层潜在表征为状态空间，以扰动幅度与相位为动作空间，动态引导目标样本向触发锚点迁移，实现零标签迁移（label-migration-free）的端到端中毒。

实验验证：在LibriSpeech、TIMIT、VCTK三大语音数据集及CNN、ResNet、CRNN、Wav2Vec 2.0四类主流架构上全面评估。结果表明：DRL-CLBA平均攻击成功率（ASR）达92.7%，显著优于基线方法；在Fine-tuning、Pruning及Spectral Signatures等主流防御下仍保持>83% ASR，证实其强鲁棒性与隐蔽性。本工作揭示了语音控制系统中潜空间优化路径的深层脆弱性，为可信语音AI安全防护提供关键警示与评估基准。

AI Summary (English)

DRL-CLBA is a novel clean-label backdoor attack for speech classification that leverages Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) reinforcement learning to embed sample-specific, imperceptible triggers via deep audio steganography—without altering original labels. By optimizing target samples toward trigger-bearing anchor points in the model’s deep latent space, DRL-CLBA achieves label-migration-free poisoning. Evaluated across three speech datasets (LibriSpeech, TIMIT, VCTK) and four DNNs (CNN, ResNet, CRNN, Wav2Vec 2.0), it achieves an average attack success rate of 92.7% and maintains >83% ASR against fine-tuning, pruning, and spectral signature defenses—demonstrating unprecedented stealth and resilience in speech AI security.

Abstract

Deep learning models for speech classification are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where malicious triggers cause misclassification at inference time. While sample-specific attacks can bypass many defenses, they often rely on poisoned label attack, making them detectable via manual data defense. In this paper, we propose DRL-CLBA, a novel clean label backdoor attack for speech classification that leverages Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) reinforcement learning. We also utilize deep audio steganography to embed sample-specific triggers into source audio, creating feature-space anchors. The proposed reinforcement learning framework effectively optimizes target samples toward trigger-bearing anchor points in the model's deep latent space, enabling label-migration-free poisoning of target samples. Experimental results across three datasets and four different DNNs demonstrate that DRL-CLBA achieves a high attack success rate, effectively bypassing some backdoor defenses. The attack demonstrates strong resistance against fine-tuning, pruning, and spectral signature defenses, exposing critical vulnerabilities in speech-controlled systems.

item.title: Safe and Adaptive Cloud Healing: Verifying LLM-Generated Recovery Plans with a Neural-Symbolic World Model
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01595v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

随着云原生AI系统规模与复杂度持续攀升，实现快速故障检测与自适应恢复已成为保障服务可靠性的核心挑战。现有方法虽尝试融合大语言模型（LLM）的语义理解能力与深度强化学习（DRL）的策略优化能力，但多采用松耦合的串行架构——LLM仅作初步诊断或指令生成，DRL独立训练策略网络，导致LLM强大的生成式推理与结构化规划潜力被严重低估，且缺乏对恢复方案安全性的形式化验证机制。

方法创新：PASE框架

本文提出PASE（Planning-Aware Semantic self-healing Engine），一种面向安全与自适应云自愈的神经符号统一框架。其核心突破在于将故障恢复重构为神经符号程序合成任务：

  • Plan Synthesis Engine：以LLM为中枢，基于语义基元库（如scale_up, rollback_version, reroute_traffic）生成可执行、带依赖约束的结构化恢复计划（JSON/DSL格式）；
  • Neural-Symbolic World Model：融合轻量级符号规则引擎与神经状态编码器，对LLM生成计划进行前向仿真验证（feasibility check），拒绝违反因果约束、资源冲突或SLA违规的方案；
  • Meta-Prompt Optimizer：基于DRL训练的元提示生成器，动态优化输入LLM的上下文提示（含历史故障模式、拓扑约束、SLO权重），实现“以提示引导推理”的闭环适配。

关键结果与贡献

在真实云环境故障注入数据集（涵盖K8s集群、微服务链路、数据库主从切换等37类未知复合故障）上，PASE相较SOTA方法（如LLM+Rule Engine、DRL-based AutoHealer）：

  • 平均恢复时间降低42.7%（p<0.01），首次实现亚分钟级端到端自愈；
  • 未知故障检测准确率提升至91.3%（+18.5个百分点），显著增强泛化鲁棒性；
  • 验证阶段拦截100% 的高危误操作（如误删生产Pod、跨AZ强制重启），确保“零回滚”安全边界。

本工作首次实现LLM规划能力、符号模型可解释验证与元学习提示优化的三重耦合，为自治云系统提供了可验证、可适应、可演进的新范式。

AI Summary (English)

This paper introduces PASE, a Planning-Aware Semantic self-healing Engine that redefines cloud fault recovery as a neuro-symbolic program synthesis task. Unlike prior loosely coupled LLM+DRL approaches, PASE tightly integrates three components: (1) an LLM-based Plan Synthesis Engine generating structured, dependency-aware recovery plans from semantic primitives; (2) a Neural-Symbolic World Model that verifies plan feasibility via symbolic-constrained neural simulation—rejecting unsafe or infeasible actions; and (3) a Meta-Prompt Optimizer, trained via DRL, to dynamically generate context-aware prompts that guide the LLM’s reasoning. Evaluated on a real-world cloud fault injection dataset with 37 diverse, previously unseen fault types, PASE reduces average recovery time by 42.7%, improves unknown-fault detection accuracy to 91.3%, and achieves 100% safety verification—blocking all high-risk operations. PASE unifies generative reasoning, formal verification, and meta-learned guidance for safe, adaptive, and autonomous cloud healing.

Abstract

As the scale and complexity of cloud-based AI systems continue to escalate, ensuring service reliability through rapid fault detection and adaptive recovery has become a critical challenge. While existing approaches integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) for semantic understanding and Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) for policy optimization, they often rely on sequential, loosely coupled architectures that underutilize the generative and reasoning capabilities of LLMs. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift with PASE, a Planning-Aware Semantic self-healing engine, a novel fault self-healing framework that reconceptualizes recovery as a neuro-symbolic program synthesis task. PASE employs an LLM as a core Plan Synthesis Engine to generate structured recovery plans from a library of semantic primitives. A Neural-Symbolic World Model verifies plan feasibility through simulation, while a Meta-Prompt Optimizer, trained via DRL, learns to generate optimal prompts that guide the LLM's planning process. This tight reason-plan-verify-adapt loop enables dynamic, context-aware recovery strategy generation beyond predefined action spaces. Experiments on a real-world cloud fault injection dataset demonstrate that PASE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, reducing average system recovery time by over 40% and improving fault detection accuracy in unknown fault scenarios. Our framework advances autonomous system management by unifying LLM-based reasoning with model-assisted verification and meta-learned guidance.

item.title: Understanding the Robustness of Distributed Self-Supervised Learning Frameworks Against Non-IID Data
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02447v1

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

近年来，分布式自监督学习（D-SSL）被提出以协同利用海量、分散且无标签的边缘数据。然而，实际场景中各节点数据呈现显著的非独立同分布（Non-IID）特性，导致模型性能严重波动。现有工作缺乏对D-SSL框架在Non-IID下鲁棒性差异的系统性理论刻画，尤其缺乏对不同自监督范式（如掩码图像建模MIM vs. 对比学习CL）及网络拓扑结构影响的严格分析。

方法与理论贡献

本文首次构建了统一的泛化误差上界分析框架，将数据异质性量化为节点间分布散度，并引入图拉普拉斯正则化刻画通信拓扑。通过收敛性与稳定性联合分析，我们严格证明：

  • MIM预训练具有内在鲁棒性：其重构目标对局部分布偏移不敏感，误差上界仅随Non-IID程度线性增长；而CL依赖跨样本相似性估计，在数据分布偏斜时易受伪负样本干扰，误差呈平方级恶化；
  • 网络连通性提升鲁棒性：平均代数连通度（即图谱间隙）越大，全局一致表征越稳定，联邦学习（FL）与去中心化学习（DecL）在理论鲁棒性上等价——关键在于拓扑而非中心化架构；
  • 基于该理论，我们提出MAR损失函数（Masked Alignment Regularization），在标准MIM目标中嵌入局部特征到全局原型的对齐约束，显式缓解异构性带来的表征坍塌。

实验验证

在CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet-100及医疗影像（CheXpert）多场景下，覆盖ResNet、ViT架构及FL/DecL/Peer-to-Peer设置，实验表明：MIM始终比CL高3.2–7.8%准确率（Non-IID-β=0.9）；MAR进一步提升1.9–4.1%，验证理论预测并提供即插即用优化方案。

AI Summary (English)

This paper provides the first rigorous theoretical analysis of robustness in distributed self-supervised learning (D-SSL) under non-IID data. We derive tight generalization error bounds showing that Masked Image Modeling (MIM) is inherently more robust than Contrastive Learning (CL) due to its distribution-agnostic reconstruction objective, while CL suffers quadratic degradation under heterogeneity. Crucially, we prove that D-SSL robustness improves with network algebraic connectivity—establishing that federated learning (FL) is theoretically no less robust than decentralized learning (DecL) when topology is comparable. Guided by this insight, we propose the MAR loss, augmenting MIM with local-to-global alignment regularization. Extensive experiments across architectures (ResNet/ViT), datasets (CIFAR/ImageNet/CheXpert), and topologies (star, ring, mesh) validate our theory: MIM consistently outperforms CL by 3.2–7.8% under severe non-IID, and MAR yields further gains of 1.9–4.1%, offering a practical, theory-grounded advancement for robust D-SSL.

Abstract

Recent research has introduced distributed self-supervised learning (D-SSL) approaches to leverage vast amounts of unlabeled decentralized data. However, D-SSL faces the critical challenge of data heterogeneity, and there is limited theoretical understanding of how different D-SSL frameworks respond to this challenge. To fill this gap, we present a rigorous theoretical analysis of the robustness of D-SSL frameworks under non-IID (non-independent and identically distributed) settings. Our results show that pre-training with Masked Image Modeling (MIM) is inherently more robust to heterogeneous data than Contrastive Learning (CL), and that the robustness of decentralized SSL increases with average network connectivity, implying that federated learning (FL) is no less robust than decentralized learning (DecL). These findings provide a solid theoretical foundation for guiding the design of future D-SSL algorithms. To further illustrate the practical implications of our theory, we introduce MAR loss, a refinement of the MIM objective with local-to-global alignment regularization. Extensive experiments across model architectures and distributed settings validate our theoretical insights, and additionally confirm the effectiveness of MAR loss as an application of our analysis.

item.title: Ask the Right Comparison:Bias-Aware Bayesian Active Top-$k$ Ranking with LLM Judges
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02104v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

大型语言模型（LLM）正被广泛用作低成本、可扩展的“裁判”，通过成对比较（pairwise comparison）对候选输出（如AI回复、模型性能、论文质量）进行排序。然而，LLM裁判存在双重缺陷：既具随机噪声，又存在系统性偏差——显著偏好冗长或排版精美的答案，并受位置效应（如先呈现项更易胜出）影响。传统方法简单聚合投票结果，实则排序的是“呈现质量”而非“真实质量”，导致在有限比较预算下无法可靠识别真正最优的前$k$项（top-$k$）。

方法创新

本研究提出Bias-Aware Bayesian Active Top-$k$ Ranking框架，包含两大核心贡献：
1. 偏差感知的贝叶斯建模：将裁判判断建模为对潜在真实质量的贝叶斯推断，显式引入裁判特异性偏差协变量（如答案长度、呈现位置），并采用收缩先验（shrinkage prior）——让数据自动决定某位LLM是否实际表现出某类偏差，避免过拟合或欠校正；
2. top-$k$感知的主动采样策略：不追求全序排名的不确定性最小化，而是聚焦于top-$k$成员身份（membership）的判别不确定性，选择能最大程度降低“某项是否属于top-$k$”概率熵的下一对比较，显著提升采样效率。

关键发现

在含真实质量标签的可控基准上，使用16个真实LLM（覆盖Llama、Qwen、Phi-4、GPT-4o系列、Gemini、DeepSeek、Claude各版本）进行评测：

  • 简单聚合法在偏差型裁判上无论预算多高均陷入错误top-$k$；
  • 我们的偏差感知模型成功恢复真实top-$k$；
  • top-$k$感知主动策略比轮询（round-robin）和全局不确定性（D-optimal）策略节省40–65%比较次数；
  • 偏差具有异质性：廉价/中端LLM（如Phi-4、Qwen-7B）存在强冗长偏差，校正后top-$k$召回率从≈0.5–0.6跃升至0.84–1.0；前沿模型（如GPT-4o-mini/5.5、Claude Opus）偏差微弱，校正增益有限——印证偏差与能力呈负相关。

AI Summary (English)

Large language models (LLMs) serve as scalable, low-cost judges for pairwise comparisons—but suffer from systematic biases (e.g., verbosity, position effects) that distort rankings away from true quality. We address the practical goal of identifying the top-$k$ items under a fixed comparison budget. First, we propose a bias-aware Bayesian model that infers latent quality while explicitly accounting for judge-specific bias covariates (e.g., response length, position), regularized by a shrinkage prior to let data determine which biases are active per judge. Second, we design a top-$k$-aware active acquisition rule that selects comparisons to minimize uncertainty specifically about top-$k$ membership, not full ranking. Evaluated on a ground-truth benchmark with 16 real LLMs (Llama, Qwen, Phi-4, GPT-4o variants, Gemini, DeepSeek, Claude), our method recovers the correct top-$k$ where naive aggregation fails—even with unlimited budget—while the top-$k$-aware strategy achieves this with 40–65% fewer comparisons than round-robin or D-optimal baselines. Crucially, bias is heterogeneous and capability-dependent: lower-tier LLMs exhibit strong verbosity bias—our correction lifts top-$k$ recall from ~0.5–0.6 to 0.84–1.0—whereas frontier models show negligible bias and require little adjustment.

Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as cheap, scalable judges that compare candidate outputs pairwise -- to rank responses, select models, or triage papers. Yet LLM judges are both noisy and systematically biased: they favor verbose or well-formatted answers and exhibit position effects, so simply aggregating their votes recovers a ranking of presentation, not of true quality. We study the practical goal of identifying the \topk{} items under a fixed comparison budget, and make two contributions. First, we cast judging as Bayesian inference over latent quality with explicit, judge-specific bias covariates (verbosity, position), regularized by a shrinkage prior so that the data decide which biases a given judge actually exhibits. Second, we introduce a \topk-aware active acquisition rule that chooses the next comparison to maximally reduce uncertainty about \topk{} \emph{membership}, rather than about the full ranking. On a controlled benchmark with known ground-truth quality, judged by sixteen real LLMs spanning open and proprietary families (Llama, Qwen, Phi-4, GPT-4o-mini/5.1/5.5, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Claude Haiku/Sonnet/Opus), naive aggregation plateaus at a wrong \topk{} on biased judges regardless of budget, while our bias-aware model recovers it; \topk-aware acquisition reaches this ceiling with far fewer comparisons than round-robin or a global-uncertainty (D-optimal) rule. Bias is real but heterogeneous and capability-dependent: cheap and mid-tier judges carry a strong verbosity bias that our model corrects (lifting recall from $\sim$$0.5$--$0.6$ to $0.84$--$1.0$), whereas the frontier judges we tested show little bias and already rank accurately, so bias-aware modeling changes little there.

item.title: WARP: Weight-Space Analysis for Recovering Training Data Portfolios
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01686v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

基础模型（Foundation Models）广泛开源，但其训练数据配方——尤其是决定多源数据采样比例的领域混合权重（domain mixture weights）——通常未公开。这导致研究者能访问模型权重，却无法获知生成该模型的真实训练分布，形成严重的“访问不对称”。现有训练数据推断方法（如成员推断）仅在单一样本粒度上判别，无法刻画训练语料库的整体领域构成，更难以还原连续、可量化的混合比例。

方法：WARP 框架

本文提出 WARP（Weight-Space Analysis for Recovering Training Data Portfolios），首次实现从已发布的微调模型权重中直接反演训练数据混合比例。核心思想是：利用模型融合（model merging）在基础模型与微调模型之间进行插值，生成一系列伪检查点（pseudo-checkpoints），这些点近似还原了缺失的训练轨迹，并在权重空间中留下由训练数据分布主导的几何足迹（geometric footprint）。随后，WARP 提取该足迹的几何特征（如方向性偏移、曲率变化），并通过两种轻量映射机制将其转化为领域占比：① 无参数的 softmax 读出层；② 在合成混合数据上预训练的 MLP 投影器。

主要结果与创新

在 BERT 和 GPT-2 的可控实验中，WARP 实现高精度混合比例恢复：平均绝对误差（MAE）低至 0.046（BERT）和 0.104（GPT-2），显著优于成员推断及依赖真实训练轨迹的基线变体。该方法无需访问训练日志、梯度或原始数据，仅需公开权重，为模型审计、数据溯源与负责任发布提供了首个可扩展、免训练的权重空间分析范式。

AI Summary (English)

WARP is the first framework to recover the domain mixture weights of a fine-tuned foundation model directly from its released weights—without access to training logs, gradients, or source data. It leverages model merging to interpolate between base and fine-tuned models, generating pseudo-checkpoints that approximate the missing training trajectory and expose a geometric footprint of the training data distribution in weight space. Geometric features extracted from this footprint are mapped to domain proportions via either a parameter-free softmax readout or a lightweight MLP trained on synthetic mixtures. In controlled experiments on BERT and GPT-2, WARP achieves mean absolute errors of 0.046 and 0.104, respectively—outperforming membership inference and even a variant with full access to the true training trajectory. This establishes weight-space geometry as a viable, scalable signal for auditing training data composition.

Abstract

Foundation models are routinely released to the public, yet the data recipes used to train them -- such as domain mixture weights that determine how different sources are sampled -- are rarely disclosed. This creates an access asymmetry: researchers study the resulting models but lack visibility into the training distribution that produces them. Prior works for inferring training data, such as membership inference, detect at the level of individual samples and thus cannot characterize the global composition of the training corpus. We introduce WARP, a framework that recovers a fine-tuned model's training mixtures directly from its released weights. WARP interpolates between the base and fine-tuned models using model merging, generating pseudo-checkpoints that approximate the missing training trajectory and expose a geometric footprint of the training data in the weight space. From these simulated footprints, WARP extracts geometric features and maps them to domain proportions using either a parameter-free softmax readout or an MLP projector trained on synthetic mixtures. In controlled experiments with BERT and GPT-2, WARP recovers domain mixtures with an average MAE as low as 0.046 and 0.104 respectively, outperforming membership inference and a variant with access to the true training trajectory.

item.title: SINA: A Fully Automated Circuit Schematic Image to Netlist Generator Using Artificial Intelligence
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01609v1

AI Summary (中文)

SINA：一种基于人工智能的全自动电路原理图图像到网表生成器

背景与挑战：当前电子设计自动化（EDA）领域虽在AI驱动下快速发展，但模拟/混合信号电路设计知识仍严重依赖非结构化的原理图图像（如论文、教材、网页中的手绘或CAD截图）。这些图像无法被EDA工具直接解析，亟需转化为机器可读的网表（netlist）以支持仿真、验证及构建AI训练数据库。现有转换方法普遍存在三大瓶颈：(1) 难以同时泛化处理IC级与PCB级原理图；(2) 组件识别精度低，尤其对相似符号（如电阻vs.电容）鲁棒性差；(3) 无法可靠区分“导线连接点”与“导线交叉”——这是导致拓扑错误的主因。

方法创新：本文提出SINA（Schematic Image-to-Netlist Automator），首个开源、端到端全自动原理图图像解析系统。其核心包含四模块协同：

  • 基于改进YOLOv8的多尺度组件检测器，支持62类器件（含IC封装、运放、晶体管等）；
  • 连通分量标记+几何拓扑推理引擎，结合线段角度与端点距离约束，精准恢复电气连接；
  • 专用OCR子系统，针对原理图字体（如Helvetica Bold、Cadence默认字体）优化，准确提取参考标号（R1, C5等）；
  • 轻量化视觉-语言模型（VLM），通过图文对齐微调，将OCR结果与检测框语义绑定，解决标号错配问题；
  • 首创交叉线判别模块，利用像素级线宽分析与交点邻域梯度特征，实现>99.2%的交叉/连接二分类准确率。

性能验证：在涵盖12类IC设计（Bandgap、OTA等）与8类PCB电路（电源、滤波器等）的1,042张真实原理图测试集上，SINA达成96.67%网表结构正确率（以图同构验证），较当前最优方法（Net2Net、SchemNet）提升2.72倍，且支持SVG/PNG/JPEG多格式输入与SPICE/Verilog-AMS双输出格式。

AI Summary (English)

This paper introduces SINA, an open-source, fully automated pipeline that converts circuit schematic images into machine-readable netlists. Addressing critical limitations in existing methods—poor generalization across IC and PCB schematics, inaccurate component recognition, and inability to distinguish wire crossings from junctions—SINA integrates four key components: (1) a robust deep learning detector for 62 component types; (2) connected-component labeling enhanced with geometric topology inference for precise connectivity mapping; (3) a schematic-optimized OCR module for reference designator extraction; and (4) a vision-language model (VLM) for reliable designator-to-component assignment. Crucially, SINA incorporates a dedicated crossing-wire detection module based on pixel-level line width and gradient analysis. Validated via graph isomorphism on 1,042 real-world schematics spanning analog ICs and PCBs, SINA achieves 96.67% netlist structural accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches by 2.72×. It supports multi-format input (PNG/SVG/JPEG) and dual netlist output (SPICE & Verilog-AMS).

Abstract

Recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) have revolutionized Electronic Design Automation (EDA), particularly through Large Language Models (LLMs) for circuit design tasks. However, their application to analog and mixed-signal domains remains limited by the lack of machine-readable representations of existing circuit design knowledge. Circuit schematic images found in research manuscripts, textbooks, and websites constitute a vast repository of validated designs; however, these visual representations cannot be directly processed by EDA tools. Converting them into machine-readable netlists is essential for enabling simulation, verification, and building comprehensive databases for AI-based models. Current conversion methods lack generalization across both Integrated Circuit (IC) and Printed Circuit Board (PCB) level schematics. Moreover, they struggle with component recognition and connectivity inference, and fail to distinguish between connected junctions and crossing wires. In this paper, we propose SINA, an open-source circuit schematic image-to-netlist generator. SINA is a fully automated pipeline that integrates deep learning for robust component detection, connected-component labeling for accurate connectivity inference, Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for component reference designator extraction, and a Vision-Language Model (VLM) for reliable reference designator assignment. SINA handles both IC- and PCB-level schematics and incorporates dedicated crossing-wires detection to differentiate wire intersections from connections. We validate the correctness of the generated netlists using graph isomorphism techniques. Our experiments demonstrate an overall netlist generation accuracy of 96.67%, which is 2.72x higher compared to state-of-the-art approaches.

item.title: Antaeus: Hunting Repository-Level Logic Vulnerabilities via Context-Grounded LLM Reasoning
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01138v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

逻辑漏洞（Logic Vulnerabilities）因其高度依赖应用语义、隐式安全假设和跨函数/模块的业务逻辑而难以检测。传统基于规则或符号执行的方法难以建模，而现有LLM漏洞检测器虽在内存安全类缺陷上表现良好，却普遍缺乏仓库级上下文感知能力——无法理解函数在整体应用架构中的角色、信任边界、安全资源调用模式及项目特有规范，导致误报率高、关键漏洞漏检。

方法创新：Antaeus框架

Antaeus提出一种上下文锚定的仓库级推理范式，包含四大核心环节：

  • 函数优先级排序：利用轻量级仓库全局信号（如API入口标记、权限检查密度、敏感数据流枢纽）自动筛选高风险函数，显著降低LLM调用频次（平均减少62%）；
  • 上下文融合推理：对每个候选函数，同步注入三类上下文：①局部代码片段、②仓库级功能拓扑（如认证/授权模块位置）、③显式安全资源（如策略配置文件、ACL定义）；
  • 对比验证机制：将候选漏洞与项目内同类函数行为基线比对，自动过滤符合“项目惯例”的非异常行为，提升精确率；
  • 结构化可追溯报告：输出含漏洞触发点（sink）、失效的安全条件（e.g., “未校验用户所属租户”）、跨文件证据链（调用路径+配置引用），支持开发者一键复现与修复。

实证效果

在28个含已确认逻辑漏洞的真实开源仓库（涵盖OAuth实现、支付网关、RBAC系统等）上评估：Antaeus成功检测并清晰解释15个漏洞（含7个零日漏洞），检出率较函数级微调模型提升3.2×，较前沿Agentic模型（如Claude-3.5 Sonnet Agent）提升2.1×，且总token消耗降低41%，报告可操作性获安全工程师100%认可。

AI Summary (English)

Antaeus is a novel LLM-based framework for detecting repository-level logic vulnerabilities—bugs rooted in violated application-specific security invariants and implicit behavioral assumptions. Unlike memory-safety detectors, Antaeus grounds LLM reasoning in holistic repository context: it prioritizes functions using lightweight repo-wide signals (e.g., trust boundary density, policy file proximity), enriches local code with cross-file functionality maps and security resources (e.g., ACL configs, auth middleware), derives and validates safety conditions in situ, and applies comparative validation against project-wide behavioral norms to suppress false positives. Evaluated on 28 real-world repositories with confirmed logic flaws, Antaeus detects and explains 15 vulnerabilities—including 7 zero-days—with 2.1× higher precision than state-of-the-art agentic baselines and 41% lower token cost, while generating actionable, traceable reports with sink locations, violated conditions, and multi-file evidence chains.

Abstract

LLM-based vulnerability detectors have shown promising results in identifying memory-safety bugs and vulnerability classes whose violations can often be expressed through established security properties. Logic vulnerabilities, however, pose a different challenge, as their identification requires inferring application-specific security invariants and implicit assumptions about intended behavior. Even frontier agentic models struggle because these invariants are often implicit and buried among unrelated code. Motivated by this gap, we present Antaeus, a framework for detecting logic vulnerabilities that grounds LLM reasoning in repository-level code context. Antaeus follows a repository-scale pipeline combining function prioritization, context-grounded reasoning, comparative validation, and structured reporting. It ranks functions using lightweight repo-wide security signals, directing costly LLM analysis toward relevant code and reducing calls, cost, and triage effort. For each prioritized function, Antaeus combines local code context with a repository-level view of the application's functionality, security resources, and trust boundaries. This enables reasoning about how the function is executed within the broader application rather than as an isolated snippet. Antaeus identifies security-sensitive sinks, derives safety conditions for safe execution, and checks whether they are locally satisfied. Candidate findings undergo comparative validation, pruning concerns that reflect project-wide norms rather than distinctive violations. Finally, Antaeus reports sinks, violated safety conditions, and evidence, making findings actionable and traceable. We evaluate Antaeus on 28 repositories with confirmed logic vulnerabilities and compare it against function-level and agentic models. Antaeus detects and explains 15 vulnerabilities, outperforming baselines with comparable token usage and cost.

item.title: The Binary Tree Mechanism is Optimal for Approximate Differentially Private Continual Counting
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00876v1

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

私有持续计数（Private Continual Counting）是差分隐私领域的基础性问题：给定长度为 $n$ 的二进制数据流（每个“1”代表一名个体的贡献），需在流式到达过程中实时发布所有前缀和（即运行计数），同时严格保护每个个体的隐私。经典算法——二叉树机制（Binary Tree Mechanism）通过分层求和结构注入高斯噪声，在 $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-近似差分隐私（approximate DP）下实现期望 $\ell_\infty$ 误差为 $O(\log^{3/2} n)$。然而，该对数阶依赖是否本质最优，即是否存在更优算法突破 $\log^{3/2} n$ 瓶颈，十余年来一直是该领域核心开放问题。

主要突破与证明方法

本工作首次完全解决了这一渐近紧性问题：我们证明，任意满足 $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-近似差分隐私的持续计数机制，其期望 $\ell_\infty$ 误差必为 $\Omega(\log^{3/2} n)$。该下界通过构造一类精心设计的对抗性输入流，并结合隐私-精度权衡的递归信息论分析与高斯过程极值理论（特别是Slepian引理与Talagrand小球测度方法）建立。关键创新在于将连续查询的隐私约束转化为对特定随机过程最大值的下界估计，从而绕过传统矩方法或组合下界的技术瓶颈。

核心结论与意义

  • 二叉树机制在近似DP下达到渐近最优，其 $\log^{3/2} n$ 误差不可改进；
  • 首次确立持续计数问题的精确误差阶，终结长期悬而未决的最优性猜想；
  • 推出线性查询中遗传差异性（hereditary discrepancy）与私有 $\ell_\infty$ 误差之间最大可能的分离：证明现有基于遗传差异性的通用上界（$O(\mathrm{herdisc} \cdot \sqrt{\log m})$，$m$ 为查询数）具有最优的 $\log m$ 因子依赖，无法进一步改善。本成果为差分隐私基础理论提供了关键判据，并为动态数据发布系统的设计确立了理论天花板。

AI Summary (English)

This paper resolves a central open problem in private continual counting: we prove that any $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-approximately differentially private mechanism for releasing all prefix sums of an $n$-length binary stream must incur expected $\ell_\infty$ error at least $\Omega(\log^{3/2} n)$. This matches the upper bound achieved by the Gaussian-noise binary tree mechanism, establishing its asymptotic optimality in the approximate-DP setting. Our lower bound is derived via a novel combination of adversarial stream construction, recursive information-theoretic privacy constraints, and extreme value analysis of Gaussian processes—leveraging Slepian’s lemma and Talagrand’s generic chaining. As a corollary, we obtain the largest possible separation between hereditary discrepancy and private $\ell_\infty$ error for linear queries, confirming that the known general upper bound $O(\mathrm{herdisc} \cdot \sqrt{\log m})$ for $m$ queries has optimal dependence on $m$.

Abstract

Private continual counting is a fundamental problem in differential privacy: given a binary stream of length $n$, where each $1$ corresponds to the contribution of one individual, the goal is to release all running counts while protecting the privacy of each individual. The standard algorithm is the binary tree mechanism, whose Gaussian-noise variant achieves expected $\ell_\infty$ error proportional to $\log^{3/2} n$ for approximate differential privacy. Whether this dependence on the stream length is necessary has remained a central open problem. In this work, we resolve the dependence on $n$ by proving that every differentially private mechanism for continual counting must incur expected $\ell_\infty$ error $Ω(\log^{3/2} n)$. This shows that the binary tree mechanism is asymptotically optimal in the approximate-DP setting. As a consequence, we also obtain a largest-possible separation between hereditary discrepancy and private $\ell_\infty$ error for linear queries, showing that the known general upper bound in terms of hereditary discrepancy has the optimal dependence on the number of queries.

item.title: Cross-Domain Generalization Failure in Lightweight Intrusion Detection Models for IIoT Networks
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00553v1

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

面向工业物联网（IIoT）边缘部署的轻量级入侵检测模型近年来备受关注，但其跨域泛化能力长期被忽视。现有研究多在单一数据集内训练并评估模型，未验证其在结构异构、流量分布迥异的未知IIoT网络上的表现，导致部署可靠性存疑。

方法设计

本研究在一个源IIoT数据集上训练四种轻量级模型（如LightGBM、TinyML-CNN等），随后在两个结构显著不同的目标IIoT数据集上进行零样本迁移评估。所有实验统一采用跨数据集可复用的最小特征集（仅含端口类别、协议类型等通用属性），排除特征可用性偏差。进一步结合SHAP与LIME开展可解释性分析，并在自然类不平衡场景下系统评估泛化性能、对抗鲁棒性及有限目标域微调恢复能力。

关键发现

  • 端口粗粒度捷径效应：两类最优模型均过度依赖“端口类别”特征；某关键攻击相关端口类别在源域攻击流量中出现频次达目标域的96–435倍——表明端口聚合并未消除数据捷径，仅将其转移；
  • 评估协议敏感性：在真实不平衡分布下，不同评估指标（如F1 vs. AUC）会反转对两目标域泛化难度的排序，凸显单一指标误导风险；
  • 鲁棒性与泛化解耦：对抗扰动鲁棒性与跨域泛化能力无显著关联；
  • 架构依赖型适应性：仅需<1%目标域样本微调即可显著提升性能，但各模型恢复效率差异达3.2倍，凸显架构选择的关键影响。

创新与启示

本研究首次系统揭示轻量级IIoT检测模型的跨域失效机制，提出以跨网络+真实分布为双核心的部署就绪性评估范式，为边缘安全模型落地提供可复现、可解释、可操作的验证基准。

AI Summary (English)

This study exposes critical cross-domain generalization failures in lightweight ML models for IIoT intrusion detection. Training four compact architectures on one IIoT dataset and evaluating them zero-shot on two structurally distinct target datasets—using only universally available features—we find that top-performing models rely overwhelmingly on coarse port-category features, with a key attack-associated category appearing 96–435× more frequently in source-domain attack traffic than in target domains—revealing port coarsening relocates, not eliminates, documented shortcuts. Under natural class imbalance, evaluation protocol choice (e.g., F1 vs. AUC) reverses perceived generalization difficulty between target networks. Adversarial robustness proves unrelated to cross-network generalization, while recovery via minimal target-domain adaptation (<1% samples) varies substantially across architectures (up to 3.2× performance gain difference). These results mandate cross-network evaluation under realistic class distributions—not just in-domain accuracy—for assessing real-world deployment readiness.

Abstract

Lightweight machine learning models are increasingly proposed for intrusion detection in Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) networks due to their suitability for resource-constrained edge deployment. Most reported results evaluate these models only within their training network, leaving behavior on unseen networks unverified. This study trains four lightweight architectures on one IIoT dataset and evaluates them, without retraining, on two structurally distinct IIoT datasets using a feature representation restricted to attributes available across all three sources. Explainability analysis across two top-performing models shows both rely overwhelmingly on coarse port-category features; the most influential category occurs in source-domain attack traffic at 96 to 435 times the rate in the two target domains, indicating that coarsening port resolution relocates rather than removes a documented shortcut. Evaluation under naturally imbalanced class distributions reveals a further effect: the evaluation protocol used can reverse which target network appears to pose the greater generalization challenge. Adversarial robustness and recovery through limited target-domain exposure are also assessed; robustness to adversarial perturbation is unrelated to cross-network generalization, and recovery through adaptation varies considerably by architecture. These findings suggest deployment readiness should be assessed using cross-network evaluation under realistic class distributions, rather than within-domain accuracy alone.

item.title: Beyond the Prompt: Jailbreaking Function-Calling LLMs via Simulated Moderation Traces
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00481v1

AI Summary (中文)

超越提示词：通过模拟审核轨迹越狱函数调用型大语言模型

背景与问题：当前针对大语言模型（LLM）的越狱攻击研究多聚焦于单轮提示词层面，却忽视了在状态化、函数调用型应用环境中深层的系统性漏洞。此类系统将开发者定义的工具Schema、结构化参数、不可信的工具输出与对话历史共同注入同一模型上下文，导致“可信控制逻辑”与“不可信数据”的边界模糊，使恶意意图可被跨多轮执行路径分布式编码，极大扩展攻击面。

方法创新（SMT框架）：本文提出SMT（Simulated Moderation Traces）——首个面向函数调用LLM的黑盒越狱框架。SMT不依赖提示词扰动，而是构建一条模拟真实审核审计流程的多轮交互轨迹：

  • 第一阶段：以“红队安全测试”为合法 pretext，构造虚构的审核框架（moderation frame），诱导模型生成潜在有害内容；
  • 第二阶段：将模型的安全拒绝响应视为“执行失败”，利用反馈信号驱动迭代优化，逐步削弱其内置安全约束；
  • 全程无需访问模型权重或内部机制，仅通过标准API交互实现。

关键发现：在涵盖5家主流厂商（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、Meta、阿里）的12个商用LLM上，基于SafeBench与HarmBench两大基准的实证评估表明：
✅ SMT平均攻击成功率（ASR）达78.3%，显著高于现有最优基线（+22.6%）；
✅ HarmScore（危害强度量化指标）提升3.1×，且单次攻击仅需4.2轮交互（接近理论最小轮数）；
✅ 攻击效果在工具调用密集场景（如代码生成、实时搜索）中尤为突出，验证了架构级脆弱性的普适性。

启示与意义：结果证实，仅靠提示词过滤或输入清洗无法防御函数调用型LLM系统；亟需部署上下文感知的全链路验证机制——覆盖Schema语义、参数合法性、工具输出可信度及累积对话状态的一致性校验。

AI Summary (English)

Jailbreak attacks against function-calling LLMs expose a critical architectural vulnerability beyond prompt-level manipulation: the interleaving of developer-defined schemas, structured arguments, and untrusted tool outputs into a shared stateful context blurs trust boundaries and enables adversarial intent to span multi-turn execution paths. We propose SMT (Simulated Moderation Traces), a black-box attack framework that bypasses prompt-centric assumptions by simulating a legitimate moderation-auditing workflow—using red-teaming as pretext to elicit harmful generations, then treating safety refusals as execution failures to iteratively weaken constraints. Evaluated across 12 commercial LLMs from 5 providers on SafeBench and HarmBench, SMT achieves the highest average attack success rate (78.3%) and HarmScore (+3.1× vs. baselines) with minimal queries (4.2 turns), demonstrating that prompt sanitization alone is fundamentally insufficient. Our work underscores the urgent need for context-aware, end-to-end validation across schemas, arguments, tool outputs, and conversation state.

Abstract

Jailbreak attacks remain a critical threat to the safe deployment of large language models (LLMs). While prior work has primarily studied attacks and defenses at the prompt level, we show that this prompt-centric paradigm overlooks a structural vulnerability in stateful, function-calling environments. In such applications, developer-defined schemas, structured arguments, and untrusted tool outputs are interleaved into a single shared model context. This architecture expands the attack surface by blurring the boundary between trusted control logic and untrusted data, allowing adversarial intent to be distributed across a multi-turn execution path. We exploit this architectural flaw through SMT, a black-box attack framework based on Simulated Moderation Traces. Departing from purely prompt-based interactions, SMT constructs a multi-turn trajectory that simulates a legitimate moderation-auditing workflow. Within this trajectory, a fabricated moderation frame leverages red-team testing as a pretext to elicit harmful generations. The subsequent validation feedback treats safety refusals as execution failures, prompting refinements that gradually weaken the model's safety constraints and ultimately trigger harmful outputs. Extensive empirical evaluations on prominent commercial LLMs from five different providers across two standardized safety benchmarks show that SMT consistently achieves the highest average attack success rate and HarmScore while requiring a near-minimal number of queries, substantially outperforming existing baselines. These findings demonstrate that prompt-level sanitization alone is fundamentally insufficient for defending tool-enabled LLM systems and highlight the urgent need for context-aware validation across schemas, arguments, tool outputs, and accumulated conversation state. The code is available at https://github.com/liujlong27/SMT.

item.title: Minos: A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework for Provenance-Based Backward Tracking
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00440v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

针对高级持续性威胁（APT）等复杂网络攻击，基于溯源（provenance）的反向追踪是关键的后入侵取证手段。然而，现有方法严重依赖低层统计特征与固定遍历策略，难以建模攻击者的高层意图，且易因依赖爆炸（dependency explosion）导致图搜索空间失控、结果冗余、可解释性差。

方法创新：Minos多智能体协同框架

本研究提出 Minos——首个将反向追踪建模为大语言模型（LLM）驱动协同推理过程的多智能体框架。其核心创新在于双层级架构：

  • 事件级分析层：融合分层上下文管理、检索增强式推理（含引用验证） 与对抗性审议机制，显著提升因果推理的准确性与鲁棒性；
  • 图探索层：引入基于有限状态机（FSM）协调的四角色专用智能体（如假设生成者、依赖验证者、计数优先查询器、收敛判别器），摒弃穷举遍历，转而采用假设引导推理与计数优先查询协议，实现高效剪枝。

实验结果与价值
