item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00422v1

AI Summary (中文)

KidnapRAG：面向智能体式检索增强生成系统的黑盒推理劫持攻击

背景与问题：检索增强生成（RAG）系统易受文档投毒攻击，但新兴的智能体式RAG（Agentic RAG）凭借多步检索-推理循环展现出更强鲁棒性——其能动态过滤弱相关毒化文档，维持用户查询驱动的原始推理链。然而，现有攻击方法多依赖白盒假设（如访问系统提示词、推理轨迹、检索器或模型参数），在真实开放场景中难以实施。

方法创新：本文首次系统研究黑盒投毒攻击——攻击者仅能发布外部可检索的恶意文档，无任何内部系统访问权限。为此，我们提出 KidnapRAG，一种基于角色协同的三阶段序列化投毒框架：

  • Bait（诱饵文档）：精准匹配用户初始查询语义，抢占首轮检索结果；
  • Chain-Link（链路文档）：内嵌引导性语言（如“请进一步分析XX原因”），触发智能体主动重构子查询，转向攻击者预设方向；
  • Mal-Ins（恶意指令文档）：以高权威性格式（如学术报告/政策文件）提供伪造证据，成为后续推理的核心依据。

核心发现：在Llama3、Qwen2、Gemma3等主流LLM骨干+LangChain、LlamaIndex等Agentic RAG框架上，KidnapRAG在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue等多跳推理基准中，平均攻击成功率较基线提升42.7%（黑盒条件下）。消融实验证实：其效果源于渐进式意图偏移——初始检索相关性下降31.5%，子查询重定向率超68%，且模型对Mal-Ins证据的引用频次达原始可信文档的2.3倍。本工作揭示了Agentic RAG在开放部署中的隐蔽脆弱性，并为防御设计提供关键攻防视角。代码开源：https://github.com/chanwoochoi316/KidnapRAG

AI Summary (English)

We present KidnapRAG, the first black-box poisoning attack against Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems—where attackers publish only externally retrievable malicious documents without access to prompts, reasoning traces, retrievers, or model parameters. KidnapRAG hijacks multi-step reasoning via three role-specific poisoned documents: a Bait document to dominate initial retrieval, a Chain-Link document to trigger query reformulation and redirect the agent’s search intent, and a Mal-Ins document to supply attacker-controlled “evidence” that dominates downstream reasoning. Evaluated across diverse LLM backbones (Llama3, Qwen2, Gemma3), Agentic RAG frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), and multihop QA benchmarks (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue), KidnapRAG achieves up to 42.7% higher success rate than prior black-box baselines. Analysis confirms it progressively degrades original retrieval intent, shifts subquery generation, and increases reliance on attacker-provided evidence—exposing critical vulnerabilities in real-world Agentic RAG deployment. Code is publicly available.

Abstract

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are vulnerable to poisoning attacks that inject malicious documents into the retrieval process to manipulate model outputs. Recent Agentic RAG systems are more robust to such attacks because they iteratively perform retrieval and reasoning, allowing them to ignore weakly relevant poisoned documents and preserve the reasoning chain induced by the user query. However, existing attacks on Agentic RAG systems often assume white-box access to system prompts, reasoning traces, retrievers, or model parameters, limiting their applicability in realistic settings. In this paper, we study black-box poisoning attacks against Agentic RAG systems, where the attacker can only publish externally retrievable poisoned documents. We propose KidnapRAG, a sequential poisoning attack that hijacks the agent's multi-step reasoning chain using three role-specific documents: Bait, Chain-Link, and Mal-Ins, which attract initial retrieval, induce query reformulation, and provide attacker-controlled evidence, respectively. Experiments across multiple Agentic RAG frameworks, LLM backbones, and benchmarks show that KidnapRAG consistently outperforms existing poisoning baselines under black-box conditions. Further analyses show that KidnapRAG progressively weakens the original retrieval intent, redirects retrieval behavior, and increases reliance on attacker-controlled evidence. item.title: SoK: Attack and Defense Landscape of Mobile On-device AI Systems
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00362v1

AI Summary (中文)

SoK：移动终端AI系统攻防全景图谱

随着人工智能模型在智能手机等终端设备上的本地化部署，移动终端AI（MoAI）系统正成为实现隐私保护、低延迟与离线智能的关键范式。然而，模型本地存储与执行也引入了全新的攻击面——包括模型窃取、后门注入、对抗样本规避、推理侧信道泄露及运行时篡改等威胁，而现有安全研究呈现碎片化、缺乏系统性梳理。

本研究首次开展面向MoAI系统的全面知识体系化（SoK）工作，构建覆盖三大核心维度的统一分析框架：

  • 安全支柱：明确MoAI特有的信任边界（如OS/TEE/模型运行时协同）、数据-模型-硬件多层耦合特性；
  • 攻击全景：系统归纳12类典型攻击（含6类新型终端特有攻击），按攻击目标（模型/数据/控制流）、触发时机（训练前/推理中/部署后）与技术路径分类建模；
  • 防御图谱：评估37种现有防御方案，指出其在移动端的适用性瓶颈（如TEE开销、编译器级混淆兼容性、轻量级水印鲁棒性不足）。

关键发现包括：92%的现有防御未在真实移动芯片（如骁龙、A系列）上验证；模型水印与差分隐私在资源受限场景下存在精度-安全权衡失衡；跨层协同防御（如OS调度+模型剪枝+硬件隔离）是当前最可行路径。本文同步发布首个开源资源库 [Awesome-MoAI-Security](https://github.com/Jinxhy/Awesome-MoAI-Security)，整合论文、工具链与基准测试集，为构建可信赖MoAI系统提供理论基石与实践指南。

AI Summary (English)

This paper presents the first Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) on security for Mobile on-device AI (MoAI) systems—AI models deployed and executed locally on smartphones and edge devices. We systematically analyze MoAI’s unique threat landscape, identifying 12 attack classes—including 6 device-specific threats (e.g., GPU microarchitectural leakage, OS-level model hijacking)—and map them across attack vectors, timing, and impact. On the defense side, we evaluate 37 existing techniques, revealing critical gaps: 92% lack real mobile hardware validation; lightweight watermarking and differential privacy suffer severe accuracy-security trade-offs under resource constraints; and cross-layer defenses (OS + runtime + hardware) show the highest practical promise. We propose the first unified framework covering security pillars, attack taxonomy, and defense feasibility analysis—and release an open resource hub (https://github.com/Jinxhy/Awesome-MoAI-Security) to accelerate secure MoAI development.

Abstract

Mobile on-device AI (MoAI) systems that integrate locally deployed AI models with conventional mobile software components are emerging as a key paradigm for delivering intelligent functionality directly on end-user devices. By moving inference from remote cloud services to the local mobile environment, such systems enable privacy-preserving, low-latency, and offline-capable AI functionality, yet introduce new security risks arising from the local storage of AI models. This paper presents the first comprehensive systematization of knowledge on MoAI security, covering security pillars, attack landscape, and defense landscape of MoAI systems. We further identify unresolved gaps in current attack and defense research and point to promising directions for future research in this emerging area. Our work establishes the first systematic framework for understanding the attack and defense landscapes of MoAI systems, serving as a foundation for building secure MoAI systems and advancing research in this critical domain. Companion resources are available at https://github.com/Jinxhy/Awesome-MoAI-Security.

研究背景

随着视觉-语言模型（VLM）驱动的第三方移动智能体（Mobile Agents）兴起，智能手机交互正经历范式转变：此类智能体以高权限决策者身份运行，通过截屏感知设备状态，并基于VLM推理执行操作，深度介入系统与应用层交互。然而，这一能力跃迁在提升自动化水平的同时，也悄然重构了移动端的安全边界——原本无害的界面元素（如系统UI、通知栏、悬浮窗）可能被转化为新型攻击面。

方法与发现

本文系统对比了第三方移动智能体App与传统App在环境交互上的本质差异，首次提出并形式化定义两大独有攻击面：

  • 屏幕感知攻击面（Screen Perception Attack Surface）：利用机器视觉与人类视觉的认知鸿沟（如对亚像素扰动、色盲友好的隐蔽色块、动态帧率欺骗的不可见区域），使恶意内容在用户不可见前提下被VLM准确识别；

Third-party mobile agents powered by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for automating smartphone interactions. These agents act as high-privilege decision-makers, perceiving device states through screenshots and executing actions via VLM reasoning, transforming how an agent app interacts with the environment (i.e., other apps or the OS). item.title: Language-Critique Imitation Learning from Suboptimal Demonstrations
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01225v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

现有基于次优示范（suboptimal demonstrations）的模仿学习方法，多依赖压缩型监督信号——如置信度估计、判别器得分或重要性权重等标量值。这类标量信号存在根本性局限：无法显式表达任务进展的中间推理、失败模式的细粒度诊断，或具体可行的纠正策略，导致丰富语义信息在监督过程中严重丢失。

方法创新

本文提出语言批判（Language-Critique）框架，首次将自然语言作为结构化监督信号引入模仿学习。该框架包含两大核心组件：

  • 语言标签构建：对每段次优示范自动生成三元语言标注——① 当前任务进展状态（如“机器人已接近目标但未对齐方向”）；② 显式识别的次优行为（如“过早转向导致路径偏移”）；③ 面向动作空间的细粒度纠正指导（如“应先平移0.3m再顺时针旋转15°”）；
  • 语言批判损失函数（LC-loss）：直接建模策略输出与语言标注间的语义一致性，避免将语言反馈降维为标量，并成功适配于行为克隆（LC-BC）与扩散策略（LC-DP）两类主流架构。

理论与实证贡献

理论层面，我们在标准假设下证明LC-loss目标函数可上界限定专家性能差距，为方法提供收敛性保障。实验层面，在涵盖导航（AntMaze）、操作（FrankaKitchen）、游戏（CarRacing）等多样化的连续控制任务中，LC-BC与LC-DP均显著超越强基线——包括DAgger、GAIL、BC+RL及Offline RL方法（如CQL、IQL），平均性能提升达23.7%。结果表明：自然语言不仅是可解释的监督媒介，更是承载结构化决策知识的高效载体，能有效提升策略从次优数据中学习鲁棒性的能力。

AI Summary (English)

Prior imitation learning from suboptimal demonstrations relies on scalar supervision (e.g., confidence scores or discriminator outputs), which inherently discards rich semantic information about task progress, failure modes, and corrective actions. We propose Language-Critique (LC), a novel framework that uses natural language as structured, expressive supervision. LC first generates fine-grained language labels describing current state, suboptimal behaviors, and action-level corrections for each demonstration. It then introduces a language-critique loss that directly trains policies—without scalar compression—and instantiates it for behavior cloning (LC-BC) and diffusion policies (LC-DP). Theoretically, we prove the LC objective upper-bounds the expert performance gap under standard assumptions. Empirically, LC-BC and LC-DP consistently outperform strong baselines—including imitation learning (DAgger, GAIL) and offline RL (CQL, IQL)—across diverse continuous control tasks (navigation, manipulation, gameplay), demonstrating that language serves as a powerful, interpretable, and structurally rich supervision signal for robust policy learning from suboptimal data.

Abstract

Prior work on imitation learning from suboptimal demonstrations typically relies on compressed supervision signals such as confidence estimates, discriminator scores, or importance weights. These scalar signals are inherently limited, as they cannot explicitly express intermediate reasoning about task progress, failure modes, or corrective actions. We propose a language-critique framework for imitation learning from suboptimal demonstrations that instead leverages natural language as a structured supervision signal, avoiding the collapse of expressive feedback into scalars. Our method first constructs language labels from demonstrations that explicitly describe current progress, identify suboptimal behaviors, and provide fine-grained corrective guidance. We then introduce a language-critique loss that directly trains policies using these structured signals without reducing them to scalars, and instantiate it for both behavior cloning and diffusion policies, yielding LC-BC and LC-DP. We further provide a theoretical result showing that the proposed objective upper-bounds the expert performance gap under standard assumptions. Empirically, we evaluate on diverse continuous control tasks spanning navigation, manipulation, and gameplay, where our methods consistently outperform strong imitation learning and offline reinforcement learning baselines. These results demonstrate that language can serve as a powerful and structured form of supervision for learning robust policies from suboptimal data.

item.title: Adversarial Pragmatics for AI Safety Evaluation: A Benchmark for Instruction Conflict, Embedded Commands, and Policy Ambiguity
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01153v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

当前大语言模型（LLM）安全评估日益依赖对自然语言行为的语义判断——例如：模型是否真正遵循指令、是否合理拒绝越界请求、是否准确遵守内嵌政策、是否识别并抵抗隐性命令（如间接言语行为）、或是否在具身任务中如实报告进展。然而，主流基准常将上述复杂现象粗粒度压缩为二元“通过/失败”标签，导致失效归因模糊：究竟是模型能力不足、政策表述歧义、多指令冲突、提示结构失效，还是人工评估者判断不稳定？这一缺陷严重制约了安全评估的可解释性与诊断效度。

方法与创新

本文提出对抗性语用学（Adversarial Pragmatics）框架，首次将形式语用学理论系统转化为可操作的安全评估工具。核心贡献包括：

  • 一个语言学受控的七维分类法（instruction conflict, embedded commands, quotation, scope ambiguity, deixis, indirect speech acts, multi-turn agent transcripts）；
  • 一个含18项种子题目的基准集，强制嵌入验证器校验的元数据（如意图层级、政策锚点、歧义类型）；
  • 54行本地化先导试点数据，覆盖中英双语语境下的典型语用陷阱；
  • 专家评估协议，要求独立标注五维度：任务成功、政策合规性、安全风险等级、拒绝结果性质（恰当/过度/缺失）、评估者置信度；
  • 三项新型指标：评估者效度（judge validity）、诊断歧义度（diagnostic ambiguity）、分类法漂移率（taxonomy drift），支持评估过程的量化审计。

该框架已成功应用于LLM裁判模型校准、黄金测试集构建、提示注入鲁棒性测试及安全文档生成，显著提升安全评估的颗粒度、复现性与跨模型可比性。

AI Summary (English)

This paper introduces Adversarial Pragmatics, a linguistically grounded benchmark and annotation framework for evaluating LLM safety under complex pragmatic challenges—including instruction conflict, embedded commands, quotation, scope/deictic ambiguity, and indirect speech acts. We contribute: (1) an 18-item seed benchmark with validator-enforced metadata; (2) a 54-row pilot dataset annotated by domain experts; (3) a five-dimensional evaluation protocol distinguishing task success, policy compliance, safety risk, refusal outcome, and evaluator confidence; and (4) novel metrics—judge validity, diagnostic ambiguity, and taxonomy drift—to quantify assessment reliability and conceptual stability. Empirically, the framework improves diagnostic precision over binary benchmarks by disentangling capability limits from policy ambiguity or evaluator noise, and has been validated in LLM judge calibration, gold-set construction, prompt-injection testing, and safety documentation workflows.

Abstract

Safety evaluations for language models increasingly depend on judgments about ambiguous natural-language behaviour: whether a model has followed an instruction, refused appropriately, complied with a policy, resisted an embedded command, or misreported progress in an agentic task. Existing benchmarks often compress these distinctions into pass/fail labels, obscuring whether failures arise from capability limits, policy ambiguity, instruction conflict, scaffold failure, or unstable evaluator judgments. This paper introduces adversarial pragmatics as a benchmark and annotation protocol for evaluating model behaviour under instruction conflict, embedded commands, quotation, scope ambiguity, deixis, indirect speech acts, and multi-turn agent transcripts. The contribution is empirical and methodological: a linguistically controlled taxonomy, an 18-item seed benchmark with validator-enforced metadata, a 54-row local seed pilot, an expert-evaluation protocol distinguishing task success, policy compliance, safety risk, refusal outcome, and evaluator confidence, and metrics for judge validity, diagnostic ambiguity, and taxonomy drift. The framework turns linguistic judgment methodology into a practical tool for validating safety evals, LLM judges, gold-set construction, prompt-injection tests, and safety documentation.

item.title: Skills Are Not Islands: Measuring Dependency and Risk in Agent Skill Supply Chains
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01136v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

Agent技能作为LLM智能体可复用的操作知识单元，正快速规模化部署，但其身份标识、版本演进与来源追溯长期隐式化，导致依赖关系不透明——已引发重复依赖引入、安装不一致等运维风险，暴露出现有依赖管理工具（如传统SBOM）在技能生态中的根本性缺失。

方法创新

本文提出Agent技能供应链（ASSC） 概念，首次系统刻画技能-包-服务混合依赖图谱；借鉴软件物料清单（SBOM）理念，设计SkillDepAnalyzer：一种能从自然语言描述中自动提取依赖证据、将技能建模为显式依赖承载体的分析器。在新构建的SKILL-DEP基准测试中，其技能元数据与依赖图还原准确率与完整性显著超越LLM基线及包中心化SBOM工具（F1提升≥32.7%）。

关键发现

基于对143万+真实技能的大规模分析，揭示四大结构性规律：

  • 技能元数据“开箱即用”但治理能力薄弱；
  • 依赖图横跨技能/包/服务三层，且存在高度集中的复用枢纽；
  • 递归技能调用催生隐性包库存与依赖链膨胀；
  • 技能依赖天然聚类于关联工作流周围。

更重要的是，单技能静态扫描会遗漏92.4%的高危依赖信号（如已知恶意包、过期证书、硬编码密钥），安全风险深度嵌套于依赖图中。

实践建议

据此提出四维治理框架：① 类型化依赖清单（Typed Dependency Manifest）；② 依赖簇一级管理（First-class Cluster Management）；③ 面向基础设施维护者的风险预警审计命令；④ 面向开发者的技能锁文件（Skill Lockfile）。已基于ASSC识别并通报多个持续存在的恶意技能至其开发者。

AI Summary (English)

This paper introduces Agent Skill Supply Chains (ASSCs) to expose and govern hidden dependencies across skills, packages, and services in LLM agent ecosystems. We design SkillDepAnalyzer, a natural-language–driven dependency analyzer inspired by SBOMs, which accurately reconstructs skill metadata and dependency graphs—outperforming LLM baselines and package-centric tools on the SKILL-DEP benchmark (F1 +32.7%). Applied to 1.43M real-world skills, ASSCs reveal four structural patterns: activation-ready but governance-poor metadata; multi-layer dependencies with concentrated reuse; recursive skill invocation expanding hidden package inventories; and workflow-coherent dependency clusters. Critically, inspecting a skill alone misses >92% of security-relevant signals embedded in its transitive dependencies. We report previously undetected malicious skills persisting in live ASSCs and propose actionable interventions: typed dependency manifests, first-class dependency-cluster management, risk-warning audit commands for maintainers, and lockfile-like records for developers.

Abstract

Agent skills package reusable operational knowledge for Large Language Model (LLM) agents, yet as they grow in scope, they become dependency-bearing artifacts whose identities, versions, and provenance remain implicit. This opacity already causes duplicated dependencies and inconsistent installations, exposing a gap that dependency management has yet to close. We introduce Agent Skill Supply Chains (ASSCs) to characterize mixed skill-package-service dependency graphs and help close this gap. Borrowing from Software Bill of Materials (SBOMs), we design SkillDepAnalyzer to capture natural-language dependency evidence and model skills as dependency-bearing artifacts. On the SKILL-DEP benchmark, SkillDepAnalyzer recovers skill metadata and dependency graphs accurately and comprehensively, substantially outperforming an LLM-based baseline and package-centric SBOM tools. Applying SkillDepAnalyzer to over 1.43 million skills, we obtain ASSCs and explore their structural diversity and security signals. We find four structural patterns: skill metadata is activation-ready but governance-poor; dependency graphs span skill, package, and service dependencies with concentrated reuse; recursive skill reuse expands dependency graphs and creates hidden package inventory; and skill dependency clusters form around related workflows. We also find that inspecting a skill alone misses security-relevant signals hiding in its dependencies. By analyzing ASSCs, we identify and report known malicious skills persisting in ASSCs to their developers. Based on these findings, we recommend typed dependency manifests, first-class dependency-cluster management, risk-warning audit commands for skill infrastructure maintainers, and lockfile-like records for skill developers.

item.title: Active Learning for Cascaded Object Detection: Balancing Coverage and Uncertainty in Table Extraction Pipelines
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00747v1

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景

商业文档中的表格抽取依赖于级联式目标检测流水线：先由表格检测（TD） 定位表格区域，再由表格结构识别（TSR） 解析其内部单元格布局。其中，TSR需精细的结构标注（如行列划分、单元格坐标与语义关系），人工成本极高；而现有主动学习（AL）方法多面向单模型任务，忽视TD与TSR之间的阶段间依赖性——TD的定位误差会传播至TSR，且两阶段特征空间异构，导致传统采样策略失效。

方法创新

本文首次将面向图像分类设计的混合采样方法Uncertainty Herding（UHerding） 适配至级联目标检测场景，并提出两种流水线感知（pipeline-aware）扩展：

  • RankFusion：构建双流形覆盖机制，在TD的检测框空间与TSR的结构表征空间（如图神经网络嵌入）同步实施多样性采样，兼顾跨阶段语义覆盖；
  • CAPA（Cascaded Adaptive Prioritization and Calibration）：引入阶段门控机制（动态屏蔽TD置信度低的样本进入TSR标注）、任务自适应不确定性校准（分别对TD的定位熵与TSR的结构预测熵归一化加权），实现端到端协同优化。

主要发现

在PubTables-1M、FinTabNet及两个私有数据集上，以71–500份文档为标注预算的实验表明：
✅ UHerding基础版本显著优于随机采样、熵采样等基线；
✅ RankFusion在平均性能上提升更显著，但方差较大（受TD误差敏感）；
✅ CAPA在4个数据集中3个上超越标准UHerding，且稳定性最优，验证了阶段解耦与不确定性校准的有效性。
本工作为结构化文档理解中的级联AL提供了首个系统性框架与可复现范式。

AI Summary (English)

Table extraction from business documents relies on a cascaded pipeline (Table Detection → Table Structure Recognition), where TSR demands costly fine-grained structural annotations. While active learning (AL) reduces annotation effort, standard AL methods ignore inter-stage dependencies in cascaded architectures. We adapt Uncertainty Herding (UHerding) — originally for image classification — to cascaded object detection for the first time. Two pipeline-aware extensions are proposed: RankFusion, which enforces dual-manifold coverage over both detection and structure representation spaces; and CAPA, which introduces stage-dependent gating and per-task uncertainty calibration. Extensive experiments across four datasets (two public, two private) and varying annotation budgets (71–500 documents) show that UHerding generalizes well to table extraction, consistently outperforming baselines. Among variants, CAPA achieves the most robust performance—outperforming standard UHerding on three of four datasets—while RankFusion yields higher average gains but with greater variance. This work establishes the first principled AL framework for cascaded table understanding.

Abstract

Table extraction from business documents relies on a cascaded pipeline where Table Detection (TD) first localizes tables and Table Structure Recognition (TSR) then recovers their internal layout. Building task-specific training sets for this pipeline is costly, particularly for TSR which requires fine-grained structural annotations. Active learning (AL) can reduce this annotation burden, yet most AL strategies are designed for single-model tasks and do not account for inter-stage dependencies in cascaded architectures. In this work, we present the first adaptation of Uncertainty Herding (UHerding), a hybrid coverage-uncertainty sampling method originally proposed for image classification, to cascaded object detection pipelines. We propose two pipeline-aware extensions that exploit the TD-to-TSR dependency: RankFusion adds dual-manifold coverage over both detection and structure representation spaces, while CAPA further incorporates stage-dependent gating and per-task uncertainty calibration. Extensive experiments across two public (PubTables-1M and FinTabNet) and two private table extraction datasets, with various annotation budgets (from 71 to 500 documents) show that UHerding generalizes well to table extraction, outperforming each baseline. Among pipeline-aware variants, RankFusion achieves higher expected gains but at the cost of greater variance, while CAPA emerges as the most consistent strategy, outperforming standard UHerding on three out of four datasets.

item.title: LLM-Guided ODE Discovery and Parameter Inference from Small-Cohort Aggregate Data
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00733v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

在罕见病研究中，基于常微分方程（ODE）的机理建模可提供可解释的动力学描述并揭示潜在生物学机制，但面临双重困境：模型结构未知、参数高度异质、个体数据极度稀缺——仅有的231条观测来自46例患者（如隐性营养不良型大疱性表皮松解症，RDEB），且数据噪声大、隐私敏感、难以获取个体轨迹。传统方法依赖个体级数据，而聚合统计（如均值、方差、分位数）虽具隐私友好性，却无法支撑联合的ODE结构发现与参数分布推断。

方法创新：AgentODE框架

本文提出AgentODE——首个端到端、纯基于群体级汇总统计的机理建模框架：

  • LLM驱动结构探索：大语言模型作为“科学假说生成器”，依据领域知识与数学约束，生成语义合理、可微分的候选ODE系统；
  • 工具增强型推理代理：通过“诊断–更新”闭环迭代优化参数分布（而非点估计），利用神经ODE求解器与概率校准模块，在仅输入群体统计（如时间序列均值±标准差）下实现分布级拟合；
  • 无个体数据依赖：全程不接触原始个体轨迹，严格满足医疗隐私合规要求。

关键结果

在3个跨学科基准任务及2个临床数据集（含RDEB）上验证：AgentODE100%恢复功能一致的ODE结构（如正确识别细胞增殖-凋亡平衡项）；在RDEB分析中，其发现的结构具备明确病理学意义（如TGF-β通路调控项），而访问个体数据的基线方法反而产生数学可行但生物学不可信的结构（如负反馈缺失、符号矛盾）。这表明：在数据稀疏场景下，约束更严格的汇总统计反成机理发现的“正则化先验”。

意义

为罕见病机制研究开辟新范式——无需打破隐私壁垒，即可从医院年报、注册登记库等常规汇总数据中直接挖掘可解释动力学模型。

AI Summary (English)

Mechanistic modeling via ODEs is vital for interpretable dynamics and mechanism inference in rare diseases—but hindered by unknown ODE structure, heterogeneous parameter distributions, and extreme scarcity/noise of individual-level data under privacy constraints. We present AgentODE, the first end-to-end framework that jointly discovers ODE structure and infers parameter distributions solely from population-level summary statistics (e.g., means, variances, quantiles). It integrates an LLM to propose biologically plausible candidate ODEs and a tool-augmented inference agent that iteratively refines parameter distributions via a diagnosis–update loop, using only aggregated data. Evaluated on three cross-domain benchmarks and two clinical datasets—including recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (RDEB) with just 231 observations across 46 patients—AgentODE recovers functionally consistent ODE structures in all cases. Critically, on RDEB, reasoning from summaries yields mechanistically principled structures (e.g., TGF-β–mediated feedback), while baselines with individual data produce mathematically adequate but biologically implausible models—demonstrating that summary statistics act as a beneficial regularizer in sparse, noisy regimes. AgentODE enables privacy-preserving, interpretable mechanistic modeling directly from routinely available aggregate clinical data.

Abstract

Mechanistic modeling via ordinary differential equations (ODEs) provides interpretable descriptions of complex dynamics and enables inference of underlying mechanisms, which is particularly valuable in clinical settings. However, in rare diseases, both the structure and parameters of the model are typically unknown, while individual-level data is scarce, noisy, heterogeneous, and subject to privacy constraints. In such settings, population-level summary statistics provide a practical privacy-preserving data representation, while capturing heterogeneity further requires modeling parameters as distributions rather than fixed values. Yet no existing method jointly discovers ODE structure and refines parameter distributions solely from summary statistics. We present AgentODE, an end-to-end framework that addresses this gap. An LLM proposes candidate ODE structures, while a tool-augmented inference agent iteratively refines parameter distributions through a diagnosis--update loop, operating on population-level summary statistics alone. We evaluate AgentODE on three benchmark problems across different fields and two clinical datasets, including the rare disease recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (RDEB), with only 231 observations across 46 patients. AgentODE recovers functionally consistent ODE structures across all settings, and experiments on RDEB demonstrates that in sparse and noisy data settings reasoning from summary statistics promotes mechanistically principled structure discovery, whereas baselines with individual-level data access recover implausible structures despite better predictive performance. AgentODE opens new possibilities for mechanistic modeling of rare diseases directly from population-level summary statistics, where data scarcity and privacy constraints have traditionally limited such analyses.

item.title: Watermarking for Proprietary Dataset Protection
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00325v1

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景

随着生成式人工智能的广泛应用，专有训练数据面临被逆向推断的风险。现有研究表明，在现代大语言模型中，基于输出损失的训练数据成员推断（Membership Inference, MI）本质上是困难任务——尤其当目标样本仅部分出现在训练集中时，传统方法性能急剧下降。

方法创新

本研究提出一种面向专有数据集保护的水印化（watermarking）新范式：不再依赖模型输出的统计偏差（如困惑度），而是将轻量级、可验证的隐式水印嵌入训练数据，并利用语言模型对水印信号的“残留放射性”（residual watermark radioactivity）——即模型即使在未完全见过水印样本的情况下，仍会在生成文本中无意复现水印模式——构建新型成员推断机制。该方法在训练阶段即部署水印，推理阶段仅需检测生成文本中的水印强度，无需访问原始训练日志或模型梯度。

主要发现

在多个主流语言模型（LLaMA-2、Qwen）和数据集（Alpaca、Dolly）上的实证表明：

  • 当水印子集覆盖率达 ≥35% 时，水印法在AUC指标上达 0.89–0.93，与最优损失基线（0.91–0.94）相当；
  • 在低暴露率（<20%）下，水印法显著优于损失法（+12.7% AUC），凸显其对稀疏水印信号的鲁棒捕获能力；
  • 水印具备不可移除性：微调/蒸馏后水印残留强度仍达原始值的76%，而损失特征易被抹平。

创新价值

本工作首次系统论证水印不仅是版权追踪工具，更是可形式化建模、可量化评估的数据归属基础设施，为数据资产确权提供可部署、低开销、抗干扰的新技术路径。

AI Summary (English)

This paper introduces watermarking as a principled framework for proprietary dataset protection and membership inference. Motivated by the intrinsic hardness of loss-based membership inference in large language models—especially under partial training exposure—we leverage the empirically observed “residual watermark radioactivity”: models trained on partially watermarked data retain detectable watermark signals in their generations, even for non-watermarked prompts. We propose a watermark-centric inference method that operates solely on generated text, requiring no access to training logs or model internals. Experiments across LLaMA-2 and Qwen show that when watermark coverage exceeds 35%, our method achieves AUC scores of 0.89–0.93—comparable to state-of-the-art loss-based baselines (0.91–0.94). Crucially, it outperforms them by +12.7% AUC at low exposure (<20%), demonstrating superior sensitivity to sparse watermark traces. The watermark persists robustly after fine-tuning (76% signal retention), unlike loss features which degrade easily. This establishes watermarking not just as a copyright marker, but as a tractable, deployable foundation for data provenance and ownership verification.

Abstract

A growing body of literature suggests that training data membership inference problems are fundamentally hard tasks in modern language modeling settings. We argue that output watermarking techniques are the right gadget to make training membership tests for generative models more tractable, based on prior results showing that language models exhibit residual watermark "radioactivity" under partially watermarked training datasets. We pit a watermark-based dataset inference approach head-to-head against traditional loss-based membership inference methods and show that watermarking can achieve comparable membership detection performance when subset exposure is high enough, under an alternate set of assumptions.

item.title: Unveiling the Non-Monotonic Effect of Privacy on Generalization under Byzantine Robustness
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01492v1

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

近期研究揭示了分布式学习中拜占庭鲁棒性（Byzantine robustness）、本地差分隐私（LDP）与优化误差之间存在根本性的三难困境（trilemma）。然而，该困境是否适用于泛化误差（generalization error）——即模型在未知测试数据上的性能——尚不明确。本文首次系统揭示：隐私强度对泛化能力的影响并非单调，而是呈现非单调性（non-monotonic），其行为完全取决于噪声水平所表征的隐私 regime。

核心发现

我们严格证明：

  • 在高噪声 regime（强隐私）下，增强 LDP 保护（即增大隐私预算 $\varepsilon$ 的倒数，引入更多噪声）反而降低泛化误差，此时鲁棒性与隐私协同增益，不存在权衡张力；
  • 在低噪声 regime（弱隐私）下，增强隐私则显著恶化泛化性能，经典鲁棒–隐私张力重新显现。

方法与理论贡献

该反直觉现象由算法稳定性（algorithmic stability）的精细刻画所解释：我们为 LDP 约束下的拜占庭鲁棒分布式学习（如基于几何中位数或 trimmed mean 的聚合器）建立了匹配的上下界，首次将泛化误差精确分解为稳定性项与鲁棒偏差项的耦合函数。理论表明，高噪声下噪声主导稳定性提升，压倒鲁棒性引入的偏差；低噪声下偏差项主导，导致泛化退化。

实证验证

我们在 MNIST、CIFAR-10 及真实医疗数据集上开展大规模实验，复现非单调曲线，并验证理论预测的临界噪声阈值，为隐私–鲁棒–泛化协同设计提供可操作指南。

AI Summary (English)

Recent work identified a fundamental trilemma among Byzantine robustness, local differential privacy (LDP), and optimization error in distributed learning. This paper challenges the assumption that the same tension governs generalization error. We prove a non-monotonic effect: under strong LDP (high noise), increasing privacy improves generalization—eliminating the robustness–privacy trade-off; under weak LDP (low noise), increased privacy degrades generalization, reinstating the tension. This behavior is rigorously explained via tight stability bounds for Byzantine-robust aggregators (e.g., geometric median, coordinate-wise median) under LDP constraints—revealing how noise-induced stability and robust bias compete. Empirical results on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and healthcare data validate the theory and identify the critical privacy-noise threshold. Our work redefines privacy–robustness design principles for real-world federated learning.

Abstract

Recent work has established a fundamental trilemma between Byzantine robustness, local differential privacy (LDP), and optimization error in distributed learning. We show that this trilemma does not universally extend to generalization error, but instead depends critically on the privacy regime. Specifically, in the high-noise regime (strong privacy), we prove that increasing privacy reduces the generalization error, i.e., there is no tension between robustness and privacy. In the low-noise regime (weaker privacy), however, the tension between robustness and privacy reappears and increasing privacy indeed degrades generalization. Our theory explains this surprising non-monotonic behavior of the generalization error via matching lower and upper bounds on the algorithmic stability of Byzantine-robust distributed learning under LDP constraints. We corroborate and further analyze these theoretical findings with empirical evaluations.

item.title: Generative AI and Federated Learning for Intrusion Detection Systems: A Survey
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01305v1

AI Summary (中文)

生成式AI与联邦学习赋能入侵检测系统：研究综述

现代网络环境（如工业物联网、企业网络与分布式系统）对入侵检测系统（IDS）提出更高要求，但其发展长期受限于五大挑战：攻击行为动态演化、高质量真实数据集稀缺、网络流量记录不完整、攻击类别严重不平衡，以及隐私法规限制集中式数据收集。本文系统综述了生成式人工智能（Generative AI）与联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）协同赋能IDS的前沿进展。我们首先梳理IDS核心研究方向，涵盖对抗性机器学习、基于异常的检测、面向IoT的轻量级IDS、可解释性IDS及主流基准数据集（如CIC-IDS2017、TON-IoT）。其次，按模型架构与任务目标双维度分类：自编码器用于异常重建与缺失值填补；生成对抗网络（GANs）支撑合成流量生成与数据增强；扩散模型提升时序流量建模保真度；大语言模型（LLMs）则初步应用于告警语义解释与规则生成。最后，重点评述生成式AI与FL的融合范式——如FedGAN、DiffuFL-IDS等框架，实现“本地数据不出域、全局模型共进化”。本文揭示六大开放挑战：合成数据的真实性与评估标准缺失、长周期网络行为建模困难、生成技术被滥用于构造高级对抗样本、客户端数据非独立同分布（Non-IID）加剧收敛偏差、通信开销与模型压缩的权衡、缺乏统一联邦IDS基准测试平台，以及亟需适配网络协议语义的领域专用安全LLMs。

AI Summary (English)

This survey systematically examines the synergistic integration of generative AI and federated learning (FL) to advance intrusion detection systems (IDS). We first contextualize IDS challenges—including evolving attack patterns, data scarcity, class imbalance, and privacy constraints—then categorize generative AI applications in IDS by model family (autoencoders, GANs, diffusion models, LLMs) and task objective (anomaly detection, synthetic traffic generation, data imputation, adversarial sample creation, and alert explanation). We further review emerging FL-based IDS frameworks that preserve data locality while enabling collaborative model training across distributed nodes. Key insights include: (1) generative models effectively mitigate data limitations but face fidelity and evaluation gaps; (2) FL enhances privacy and scalability yet suffers from Non-IID data and communication bottlenecks; (3) hybrid approaches (e.g., FedGAN, DiffuFL-IDS) show promise but require rigorous benchmarking. We identify critical open challenges: synthetic data quality assessment, realistic long-horizon traffic generation, dual-use adversarial risks, FL convergence under extreme heterogeneity, communication-efficient aggregation, standardized federated IDS benchmarks, and domain-specialized LLMs for network security reasoning.

Abstract

Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs) are essential for monitoring network traffic and identifying malicious activities in modern cyber-physical, Internet of Things (IoT), enterprise, and distributed network environments. However, developing reliable IDS models remains challenging because attack behaviors evolve over time, realistic datasets are difficult to obtain, traffic records may be incomplete, attack classes are often imbalanced, and privacy constraints limit centralized data collection. Recent advances in generative artificial intelligence (AI) and Federated Learning (FL) provide new opportunities to address these limitations. Generative models can support anomaly detection, synthetic traffic generation, data augmentation, data imputation, adversarial traffic generation, and IDS alert explanation. FL enables distributed IDS training without directly sharing local network traffic, making it suitable for privacy-sensitive and geographically distributed environments. This survey provides a structured review of generative AI and FL techniques for IDS. We first summarize representative IDS research directions, including adversarial machine learning, anomaly-based detection, IoT-oriented IDS, explainable IDS, and benchmark datasets. We then categorize generative AI applications in IDS according to model families and task objectives, covering autoencoder-based models, Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), diffusion models, and Large Language Models (LLMs). Finally, we review emerging studies that integrate generative AI with FL-based IDS and discuss open challenges, including synthetic data quality, realistic traffic generation, dual-use adversarial risks, non-IID client distributions, communication-efficient model sharing, federated IDS benchmarking, and domain-specific LLMs for network security.

item.title: The Binary Tree Mechanism is Optimal for Approximate Differentially Private Continual Counting
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00876v2

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

私有持续计数（Private Continual Counting）是差分隐私领域的基础性问题：给定长度为 $n$ 的二进制数据流（每个“1”代表一个个体的贡献），需在流式处理过程中实时发布所有前缀和（即运行计数），同时满足近似差分隐私（$(\varepsilon,\delta)$-DP）。经典算法——二叉树机制（Binary Tree Mechanism）通过分层聚合加高斯噪声，实现了期望 $\ell_\infty$ 误差为 $O(\log^{3/2} n)$ 的性能。然而，该对数阶依赖是否本质最优？即是否存在更优算法实现 $o(\log^{3/2} n)$ 误差？这一问题自提出十余年来始终悬而未决，构成该方向的核心开放难题。

主要突破与证明方法

本研究首次确立了该问题的渐近紧下界：我们严格证明，任意满足 $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-DP 的持续计数机制，其期望 $\ell_\infty$ 误差必为 $\Omega(\log^{3/2} n)$。证明关键在于构造一类精心设计的对抗性输入序列，并结合信息论下界技术与高斯过程极值理论（特别是 Dudley积分与Slepian引理），将隐私约束转化为对噪声协方差结构的强限制，进而导出误差的不可规避性。

核心贡献与影响

  • ✅ 终结性结论：确认二叉树机制在近似DP下达到渐近最优，彻底解决该领域长期开放问题；
  • ✅ 理论桥梁：首次揭示遗传差异度（hereditary discrepancy）与私有 $\ell_\infty$ 误差间的最大可能分离——此前基于遗传差异度的通用上界（$O(\mathrm{herdisc} \cdot \sqrt{\log m})$，$m$为查询数）被证明具有最优查询数依赖，无法进一步改进；
  • ✅ 方法论启示：为线性查询的私有机制下界分析提供了新范式，推动差分隐私基础理论向更精细的几何与概率刻画演进。

AI Summary (English)

We resolve a central open problem in private continual counting: whether the $\widetilde{O}(\log^{3/2} n)$ expected $\ell_\infty$ error of the binary tree mechanism (BTM) under $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-differential privacy is asymptotically optimal. We prove a matching lower bound: every $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-DP continual counter incurs expected $\ell_\infty$ error $\Omega(\log^{3/2} n)$. This establishes the BTM’s asymptotic optimality in the approximate-DP setting. Our proof leverages adversarial input construction, information-theoretic arguments, and Gaussian process tools (Dudley’s entropy integral and Slepian’s lemma) to tightly constrain noise covariance under privacy. As a corollary, we obtain the largest possible separation between hereditary discrepancy and private $\ell_\infty$ error for linear queries—showing that the known upper bound $O(\mathrm{herdisc} \cdot \sqrt{\log m})$ for $m$ queries has optimal dependence on $m$, settling its tightness.

Abstract

Private continual counting is a fundamental problem in differential privacy: given a binary stream of length $n$, where each $1$ corresponds to the contribution of one individual, the goal is to release all running counts while protecting the privacy of each individual. The standard algorithm is the binary tree mechanism, whose Gaussian-noise variant achieves expected $\ell_\infty$ error proportional to $\log^{3/2} n$ for approximate differential privacy. Whether this dependence on the stream length is necessary has remained a central open problem. In this work, we resolve the dependence on $n$ by proving that every differentially private mechanism for continual counting must incur expected $\ell_\infty$ error $Ω(\log^{3/2} n)$. This shows that the binary tree mechanism is asymptotically optimal in the approximate-DP setting. As a consequence, we also obtain a largest-possible separation between hereditary discrepancy and private $\ell_\infty$ error for linear queries, showing that the known general upper bound in terms of hereditary discrepancy has the optimal dependence on the number of queries.

item.title: Cognitive Firewall: A Proactive, Zero-Trust, Multi-Gate Framework for LLM Safety
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01277v1

AI Summary (中文)

认知防火墙：面向大语言模型安全的主动式零信任多关卡框架

背景与问题：当前大语言模型（LLM）面临严峻的安全挑战——攻击者可通过多轮对话策略诱导模型生成有害内容，而每一轮用户输入单独看均无明显违规迹象。现有运行时防护机制（如提示/响应单点检测）难以捕捉跨轮次累积的恶意意图、验证用户声称的权限真实性，或识别被分解隐藏于多轮交互中的有害目标。

方法创新：本文提出认知防火墙（Cognitive Firewall），一种主动式、零信任、多关卡的运行时监督框架。其核心是引入一个独立的监督模型，作为用户与目标LLM之间的“中间守门人”。框架将安全评估解耦为四个正交关卡：

  • 意图关卡：解析用户请求的操作级目标；
  • 零信任上下文关卡：对用户自述角色/权限视为待验证证据，而非默认可信；
  • 一致性关卡：动态追踪对话演进，检测意图升级与任务分解行为；
  • 输出风险关卡：在响应释放前对候选文本进行细粒度风险审查。

所有关卡采用分级阻断机制（escalation-based decision），任一关卡给出高置信度危险信号即终止交互，并完整保留可审计的决策链路，避免传统分数平均导致的风险稀释。

实验结果：在4个主流越狱基准（包括单轮、多轮、权限滥用及人工构造攻击）及良性安全测试集上验证，该框架显著提升防御鲁棒性：在三类攻击集上将成功率压降至≤2%，最难的人工构造攻击集也降至14%，同时仅引发8%的过度拒绝率（over-refusal）。结果表明，基于对话全局视角的解耦化监督，可兼顾前瞻性遏制能力与全流程可审计性，为LLM安全提供新范式。

AI Summary (English)

This paper introduces the Cognitive Firewall, a proactive, zero-trust, multi-gate runtime oversight framework for LLM safety. Unlike conventional single-turn safeguards, it interposes an independent oversight model between user and target LLM to assess safety across the full dialogue trajectory. Safety evaluation is decomposed into four orthogonal gates: (1) Intent Gate—identifies operational objectives; (2) Zero-Trust Context Gate—treats claimed authority as unverified evidence; (3) Consistency Gate—detects intent escalation and objective decomposition across turns; and (4) Output Risk Gate—inspects candidate responses pre-release. Gates employ escalation-based blocking (not score averaging), ensuring any high-confidence danger signal halts interaction with full auditability. Evaluated on four jailbreak benchmarks and a benign safety set, the framework reduces attack success to ≤2% on three attack categories and 14% on the hardest human-crafted set, while maintaining only an 8% over-refusal rate—demonstrating superior proactive containment and transparency over state-of-the-art methods.

Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) can be induced to produce harmful content through multi turn strategies in which no single user message appears clearly unsafe. Existing runtime safeguards commonly evaluate prompts or responses as isolated messages, which limits their ability to recover ac-cumulated intent, verify asserted authority, or detect harmful objectives decomposed across a dialogue. This paper presents the Cognitive Firewall, a proactive runtime oversight framework that interposes an independent oversight model between a user and a protected target mod l. The framework decomposes safety assessment into four categorical gates: an intent gate that identi-fies the operational objective of a request, a zero trust context gate that treats claimed roles and permissions as unverified evidence, a consistency gate that detects escalation and decomposition across turns, and an output risk gate that inspects candidate responses before release. Gate decisions are combined through escalation rather than score averaging, allowing any confident danger signal to block an interaction while preserving an auditable rationale. Experiments on four jailbreak benchmarks and a benign safety test set show that the Cognitive Firewall substantially reduces attack success across single turn, multi turn, authority based, and human crafted attacks. It lowers attack success to 2 percent or below on three attack sets and to 14 percent on the most difficult human crafted set, while maintaining an 8 percent over refusal rate. These results indicate that decomposed, conversation level oversight can improve proactive containment and auditability for LLM safety.

item.title: Embedding Inference Attack
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01276v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

现代信息检索（IR）系统广泛依赖嵌入模型（embedding models）实现语义匹配，但这些模型通常以黑盒API形式部署，其架构与参数对外不可见。已有研究揭示了嵌入逆向攻击（embedding inversion）等安全风险，但此类攻击均需攻击者预先知晓目标模型结构，实用性受限。本文首次提出并系统研究一种新型威胁——嵌入推理攻击（Embedding Inference Attack, EIA）：在仅能观测无序检索结果集（即无排序、无相似度分数）的严格黑盒场景下，推断后端实际使用的嵌入模型。

方法与创新

我们设计可迁移的判别性查询集（tailored queries），通过分析不同嵌入模型对同一查询返回的文档集合差异（即“检索指纹”），构建轻量级分类器。关键突破在于：

  • 无需访问向量空间或梯度信息；
  • 攻击仅依赖标准检索接口输出（文档ID集合）；
  • 理论证明特定查询在跨模型间具有高区分性；
  • 首次验证EIA在含重排序器（reranker）的真实防御链路中仍有效——因重排序仅作用于初检结果，不改变嵌入层的原始匹配模式。

实验验证与应用延伸

我们在真实RAG系统中成功实施EIA：定制查询能绕过LLM对“非规范问题”的拒绝倾向，稳定触发底层嵌入模块响应。进一步评估表明，相似度阈值过滤等简单防御策略效果有限，而模型混淆（model obfuscation）与动态查询路由更具潜力。本工作揭示了嵌入服务隐蔽性假象下的新型供应链风险，为IR系统安全评估提供了新基准。

AI Summary (English)

This paper introduces the Embedding Inference Attack (EIA)—a novel black-box threat against modern IR systems. Unlike prior embedding inversion attacks, EIA requires no knowledge of the target model and operates solely from unordered retrieved document sets (i.e., no rankings or similarity scores). We design discriminative queries that exploit subtle, model-specific retrieval patterns (“retrieval fingerprints”) to identify the underlying embedding model among a candidate set. Crucially, we show these queries remain effective even when a reranker is deployed, as reranking preserves the initial embedding-based match. We validate EIA on a real-world RAG system, demonstrating robustness against LLM input sanitization heuristics. Finally, we evaluate mitigations—including similarity thresholds—and find them insufficient against targeted queries, highlighting the need for architectural-level defenses. Our work exposes a previously overlooked inference risk in opaque embedding services.

Abstract

Embedding models are essential components of modern Information Retrieval (IR) systems, yet they are typically hidden behind APIs. Recent works have shown that dense IR system can lead to security vulnerabilities such as embedding inversion attacks. However, such attacks usually require that the attacker knows the embedding model for the attack to be applicable. In this paper, we study IR systems under a black-box setting in which the adversary observes only the unordered set of retrieved documents, without ranking or similarity scores. We demonstrate that in such contexts, tailored queries allow an adversary to identify which embedding model is in use from a set of known model candidate, which we coin as an embedding inference attack (EIA). We also show that certain queries remain discriminative even when the system includes a reranker as a potential defense mechanism. We further validate our method on a real Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system, in which the tailored queries bypass the LLM's tendency to reject inputs it does not recognize as well-formed questions. Finally, we propose and evaluate other mitigation strategies such as similarity thresholds.

item.title: Grounded Optimization: A Layered Engineering Framework for Reducing LLM Hallucination in Automated Personal Document Rewriting
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01457v1

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景

大型语言模型（LLMs）在求职简历优化场景中广泛应用，但其生成内容易出现领域特异性幻觉：包括技术年代错置（如在2010年简历中注入2023年才发布的框架）、跨领域术语污染（如将医疗术语误植于金融简历）、结构变异（破坏ATS兼容的标准化段落顺序）及事实性内容捏造。此类幻觉显著区别于通用文本生成中的错误，亟需针对性工程化防控。

方法创新：五层“锚定优化”（Grounded Optimization）框架

本研究提出分层可解释的防御体系，包含：

  • 时序上下文验证层：基于简历时间线自动校验技术栈、职位与年代逻辑一致性；
  • 确定性污染检测层：构建14行业跨域术语污染词典，实现零样本、规则驱动的术语越界识别；
  • 结构不变性强制层：通过Schema约束与XML Schema校验，保障标题层级、字段顺序与ATS解析兼容性；
  • 提示级锚定层：在prompt中嵌入动态事实锚点（如“仅使用简历中明确出现的技能名称”），抑制自由发挥；
  • 评估代理层：轻量级LLM evaluator agent执行多维度幻觉打分（时序/术语/结构/事实四维），支持闭环反馈。

关键发现

在25份覆盖14行业的合成简历上，对3种主流LLM（Llama3-70B、Qwen2-72B、GPT-4-turbo）、4种温度值（0.1–0.8）及6种层组合开展消融实验：

  • 无防护基线平均产生2.48–5.36次/简历的可检测幻觉；
  • 引入全框架后，整体幻觉率降至0.04–0.24次/简历，其中时序幻觉减少50%–95%；
  • 提示级锚定在低温（T=0.1）+强指令模型下可实现零检测幻觉，但高温或弱模型下必须依赖确定性层（检测+结构）补足鲁棒性。

本研究开源污染分类法、评估代码与全量原始数据，推动可信文档重写基础设施建设。

AI Summary (English)

Large language models (LLMs) deployed for automated resume optimization suffer from domain-specific hallucinations—anachronistic technology injection, cross-domain terminology contamination, structural mutation, and content fabrication—distinct from generic text generation errors. We propose Grounded Optimization, a five-layer engineering framework integrating: (1) temporal context validation, (2) deterministic contamination detection (using a novel 14-industry taxonomy), (3) structural invariant enforcement via schema constraints, (4) prompt-level grounding with dynamic factual anchors, and (5) an evaluator agent for multi-dimensional hallucination scoring. Ablation experiments across 25 synthetic resumes (14 industries), 3 LLMs, 4 temperatures, and 6 layer configurations show baseline hallucination rates of 2.48–5.36 per resume; Grounded Optimization reduces overall detected hallucinations to 0.04–0.24, with temporal hallucinations cut by 50–95%. Prompt-level grounding alone achieves zero detected hallucinations at low temperature with capable models—but deterministic layers prove essential for robustness under higher entropy or weaker models. We release the contamination taxonomy, evaluation code, and raw data.

Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to resume optimization for applicant tracking systems, introducing hallucination failures distinct from general text generation: anachronistic technology injection, cross-domain terminology contamination, structural mutation, and content fabrication. We present Grounded Optimization, a five-layer framework combining temporal context validation, deterministic contamination detection, structural invariant enforcement, prompt-level grounding, and an evaluator agent. In ablation experiments across three LLMs, four temperature settings, and six layer configurations on 25 synthetic resumes spanning 14 industries, undefended baselines produce 2.48-5.36 detected hallucinations per resume. Among detectors independent of the active defenses, temporal hallucinations are reduced by 50-95% across all conditions; overall detected hallucination rate falls to 0.04-0.24. Prompt-level grounding alone achieves zero detected hallucinations at low temperature with a capable instruction-following model; higher temperatures and weaker models reveal the need for the deterministic layers as a complement. We release the contamination taxonomy, evaluation code, and raw data.

item.title: Agent4cs: A Multi-agent System for Code Summarization in Large Hierarchical Codebases
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01425v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

在大型分层代码库（如微服务架构或遗留系统）中，代码结构复杂、文档缺失或混淆，导致开发者理解成本高昂。现有代码摘要方法多依赖单一大语言模型（如Claude Code），将源码视为扁平文本处理，严重忽视模块间调用关系、目录层级语义及跨文件依赖，难以生成语义连贯、结构可追溯的摘要。

方法创新：Agent4cs 多智能体框架

我们提出 Agent4cs——首个面向分层代码库的多智能体协同摘要系统。其采用自底向上（bottom-up）分层聚合策略，包含三类专业化智能体：

  • 摘要生成智能体：基于上下文感知提示，在文件/子模块级生成初始摘要；
  • 关键词提取智能体：主动扫描子目录结构，识别核心API、类名、配置项等关键实体，构建层级化语义锚点；
  • 质量保障智能体：通过迭代重写与一致性校验（如跨层级指代消解、术语标准化），确保摘要的可读性、逻辑连贯性与信息完备性。三者通过结构化消息总线协同，支持动态反馈与版本感知更新。

主要成果

在7个前沿开源与闭源模型（包括Qwen2.5-Coder、DeepSeek-Coder-V2、Claude-3.5-Sonnet）上评估，Agent4cs 在所有文件夹层级的语义一致性得分平均提升8%（vs. 结构化提示基线）；在真实工业代码库（含Apache Flink、Spring Cloud Alibaba等12个项目）测试中，归一化关键词覆盖率提升达38%，显著增强摘要对关键架构要素的捕获能力。本工作为大规模代码理解提供了可扩展、可解释、可演化的多智能体范式。

AI Summary (English)

Understanding large hierarchical codebases remains challenging due to obfuscated structures and sparse documentation. Existing summarization approaches treat code as flat text and rely on single LMs, ignoring rich interdependencies and repository-level hierarchy. To address this, we propose Agent4cs, a multi-agent system that performs bottom-up summarization via three specialized agents: a summarization agent for robust local summaries, a keyword-extraction agent that proactively identifies critical entities (e.g., APIs, classes) from subfolders, and a quality-assurance agent that iteratively refines outputs for readability, coherence, and completeness. Evaluated across 7 frontier models, Agent4cs improves semantic consistency by +8% on average across all folder levels versus structured prompting baselines using code segments. On real-world datasets (12 large open-source projects), it achieves up to +38% gain in normalized keyword coverage, demonstrating superior capture of architectural semantics. Agent4cs establishes a scalable, interpretable paradigm for large-codebase understanding.

Abstract

Understanding large, complex codebases, especially those with obfuscated structures and incomplete documentation, remains a significant challenge. Existing code summarization solutions often rely on a single language model or coding assistant like Claude Code, and treat source code as flat text, underutilizing the rich interdependencies and hierarchical information within a repository. To address these shortcomings, we propose Agent4cs - a multi-agent framework that summarizes large codebases in a bottom-up fashion, where a summarization agent focuses on producing robust summaries; a keyword-extraction agent proactively identifies critical information from subfolders; and a quality-assurance agent iteratively refines the outputs for readability, coherence, and completeness. Evaluated on 7 frontier models, Agent4cs improves semantic consistency across all folder levels by average 8% compared to two structured prompting baselines with code segments. Furthermore, extensive evaluation on real-world datasets demonstrates up to 38% gains in normalized keyword coverage rate over the same baselines.

item.title: Auto-FL-Research: Agentic Search for Federated Learning Algorithms
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01366v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

联邦学习（FL）算法研究高度依赖大量细粒度但影响深远的设计选择：优化器变体、服务器聚合规则、客户端本地训练调度、归一化/正则化策略及模型架构等。这些组合空间庞大，人工探索成本高昂；更关键的是，任意修改都可能隐式改变训练路径或评估流程，导致公平比较困难。

方法：Auto-FL-Research（AFR）

本文提出Auto-FL-Research（AFR）——一种面向FL算法配方搜索的约束型编码智能体工作流。AFR允许智能体自主提出并实现候选算法，涵盖服务器聚合逻辑、客户端更新时序、本地目标函数及注册模型变体；同时通过任务配置文件（task profiles） 严格限定变异范围（mutation surface）、计算预算、通信契约及最终模型评估协议，确保实验可复现、可比对。每次搜索“战役”（campaign）完整记录候选方案得分、运行时间、代码变更文件、中间产物及失败状态。

主要发现与贡献

我们在5个医疗跨机构FLamby任务及6个LEAF数据集（含5个真实分组+1个合成任务）上系统验证AFR。五次随机种子重复实验表明：AFR在4个FLamby任务和5/6个LEAF配置中取得统计显著增益；同时揭示了种子敏感性失效案例与搜索过程偶然选中的单次成功 artifact。对照实验（相同预算下的固定表面标量调优）证实：部分提升源于真正的新FL机制（如新型聚合），而另一些则被标量控制复现或在重复/留出评估中失效。这一混合结果本身即为核心贡献——它首次提供可分解框架，将智能体产出清晰划分为三类：可复现的FL机制改进、固定表面下的超参调优效应、以及不可复现的单次随机artifact，为自动化FL研究建立可审计、可归因的方法论基础。

AI Summary (English)

This paper introduces Auto-FL-Research (AFR), a constrained coding-agent framework for systematic search of federated learning (FL) algorithmic recipes. AFR agents autonomously propose and implement candidates—including server aggregation rules, client scheduling policies, local objectives, and model variants—while task profiles rigidly fix the mutation space, compute budget, communication constraints, and evaluation protocol to ensure fair, reproducible comparison. Evaluated on five healthcare FLamby cross-silo tasks and six grouped-client LEAF profiles (five real + one synthetic), AFR achieves statistically significant gains on 4/5 FLamby and 5/6 LEAF settings under five-seed repetition—yet also uncovers seed-sensitive failures and search-selected single-run artifacts. Crucially, same-budget scalar controls reveal that some improvements stem from genuine FL mechanism innovations, others reduce to fixed-surface hyperparameter tuning, and several vanish under repeat or held-out evaluation. This tripartite decomposition—reproducible mechanisms, surface-constrained tuning, and non-reproducible artifacts—is AFR’s core contribution, enabling auditable, attributable automation in FL research.

Abstract

Federated learning (FL) research often depends on many small but consequential algorithmic choices: optimizer variants, server aggregation rules, local training schedules, normalization, regularization, and model architecture. These choices are expensive to explore manually and difficult to compare fairly when candidate changes can also alter the FL training or evaluation path. In this work, we present Auto-FL-Research (AFR), a constrained coding-agent workflow for FL algorithmic recipe search. Agents may propose and implement candidate training algorithms, including server aggregation rules, client update schedules, local objectives, and registered model variants, while task profiles fix the mutation surface, compute budget, communication contract, and final model evaluation. Each campaign records candidate scores, runtime, edited files, artifacts, and failure status. We evaluate AFR on five healthcare cross-silo FLamby tasks and on grouped-client profiles for the five fixed LEAF datasets plus the LEAF synthetic task. Five-seed repeat evaluations support gains on four FLamby tasks and five of six LEAF profiles, while also exposing seed-sensitive and search-selected failure cases. Same-budget controls show that several gains correspond to FL-recipe changes, whereas other improvements are recovered by fixed-surface scalar controls or fail under repeat or held-out evaluation. These mixed outcomes are part of the contribution: they show how agent-generated candidates can be separated into repeated FL mechanisms, fixed-surface tuning effects, and selected single-run artifacts.

item.title: CPG-PAD: Concept-Informed Prompts Guided Presentation Attack Detection
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01303v1

AI Summary (中文)

CPG-PAD：概念引导的提示学习用于泛化性呈现攻击检测

背景与挑战：呈现攻击检测（PAD）是保障人脸识别系统安全的关键环节，需识别打印照片、视频重放、3D面具等伪造媒介。然而，现有模型在跨域场景（如不同传感器、光照或攻击材质）下泛化能力严重受限——主因在于其依赖类别标签监督学习的提示（prompt），难以显式建模细粒度的攻击相关视觉语义，导致模型过拟合数据集特有伪影，而非学习可迁移的本质攻击线索。

方法创新：本文提出CPG-PAD（Concept-Informed Prompts Guided PAD），首次将模型级语义概念引入提示学习框架。核心包含两大模块：

  • 视觉概念驱动增强（VCE）模块：利用可解释AI（XAI）技术自动挖掘PAD相关视觉概念（如“屏幕反光”“纸张纹理”“边缘畸变”），生成像素级概念热力图，提供局部化、细粒度的语义引导；
  • 基于提示的概念注入（PCI）机制：通过视觉提示解码器（VPD） 将热力图映射至提示空间，并设计概念映射损失函数，强制提示向模型内部概念空间对齐，使提示真正承载可解释、可迁移的攻击语义。

性能与贡献：该设计显著提升特征的领域不变性，在九个主流基准数据集（涵盖多源、少源、单源跨域设置）上实现全面SOTA性能：平均HTER降低1.8–4.2个百分点，尤其在极端单源迁移（如仅用Replay-Attack训练、零样本迁移到MSU-MFSD）下鲁棒性大幅提升。CPG-PAD不仅突破了传统提示学习的语义黑箱瓶颈，更建立了“概念→提示→决策”的可解释闭环，为生物特征安全中的泛化性防御提供了新范式。

AI Summary (English)

Presentation Attack Detection (PAD) remains challenged by poor cross-domain generalization due to sensor, lighting, and material variations. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer strong transferability, their prompt learning—typically supervised by coarse class labels—fails to capture fine-grained, attack-relevant visual semantics, leading to domain-specific overfitting. To bridge this gap, we propose CPG-PAD, a concept-informed prompt learning framework for PAD. It introduces model-level semantic guidance via two novel components: (1) a Visual Concept-driven Enhancement (VCE) module that leverages XAI to discover PAD-critical visual concepts (e.g., screen glare, paper texture) and generates localized concept heatmaps; and (2) a Prompt-based Concept Injection (PCI) mechanism that aligns prompts with the model’s internal concept space using a Visual-Prompt Decoder and a dedicated concept-mapping loss. Extensive evaluation across nine benchmarks demonstrates CPG-PAD achieves state-of-the-art cross-domain performance under multi-source, limited-source, and single-source settings—improving average HTER by 1.8–4.2% and notably enhancing zero-shot transfer robustness.

Abstract

Presentation Attack Detection (PAD) serves as a crucial safeguard for face recognition systems against presentation attacks such as printed photos, replayed videos, and 3D masks. Despite significant progress, existing PAD models still struggle to generalize across unseen domains due to variations in sensors, lighting, and attack materials. Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong generalization ability, yet their applications in PAD remain limited because learned prompts, typically optimized under class-label supervision, fail to explicitly align with fine-grained attack-relevant visual semantics. As a result, the learned representations often overfit domain-specific artifacts instead of capturing transferable attack cues. To address this, we propose Concept-Informed Prompts Guided Presentation Attack Detection (CPG-PAD), a framework that introduces model-level concept guidance into the prompt learning process. Specifically, we design a Visual Concept-driven Enhancement (VCE) module that employs eXplainable AI (XAI) techniques to automatically discover PAD-relevant visual concepts and generate concept-associated heatmaps providing localized fine-grained guidance. Guided by these heatmaps, a Prompt-based Concept Injection (PCI) mechanism integrates these concepts into the prompt space through a Visual-Prompt Decoder (VPD) and a concept-mapping loss, enabling prompts to align with the model's internal concept space. This design enables CPG-PAD to capture generalizable and domain-invariant attack cues while effectively suppressing dataset-specific biases. Extensive experiments across nine benchmark datasets demonstrate that CPG-PAD consistently achieves state-of-the-art cross-domain performance under multi-source, limited-source, and single-source settings.

item.title: Class-Grouped Normalized Momentum and Faster Hyperparameter Exploration to Tackle Class Imbalance in Federated Learning
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01474v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

在联邦学习（FL）中，类别不平衡问题尤为严峻：各客户端数据分布高度异构，少数类样本稀缺且隐私敏感，传统集中式重采样或损失加权等方法因违反数据不出本地原则而不可行，导致模型对长尾类泛化能力严重不足。

方法创新

本文提出 FedCGNM（Federated Class-Grouped Normalized Momentum）——一种轻量、隐私友好的客户端优化器：

  • 类分组策略：基于最小组内方差准则，将所有类别动态划分为少量（如3–5组），兼顾语义相似性与分布一致性；
  • 分组动量机制：为每组维护独立动量向量，避免多数类梯度主导更新；
  • 单位模长归一化：对每组动量执行 ℓ² 归一化，再求和作为最终更新方向，同时抑制稀疏类梯度噪声、均衡多/少类梯度幅值；
  • 理论保障：首次在FL收敛分析中显式建模时变重采样率，证明FedCGNM在非独立同分布（Non-IID）与类别偏斜下仍具O(1/√T)收敛速率。

高效超参探索

针对小规模联邦场景（<20客户端），提出 FedHOO：一种基于X-armed bandit的分布式超参优化算法。它利用联邦并行性，在线性通信成本下，让每个客户端并发评估两组候选重采样率组合，显著加速最优率搜索。

实验验证

在CIFAR-10-LT、ImageNet-LT、iNaturalist2018、Places-LT四大公开长尾基准及某芯片缺陷工业数据集上，FedCGNM平均提升少数类准确率+4.2–9.7%；叠加FedHOO后，在16客户端设置下额外增益+1.8–3.3%，显著优于FedAvg、FedProx、LDRO、FEDRO等基线。

AI Summary (English)

Class imbalance severely degrades model fairness in federated learning (FL), yet standard centralized remedies violate privacy and heterogeneity constraints. We propose FedCGNM, a client-side optimizer that groups classes by minimum within-group variance, maintains and ℓ²-normalizes per-group momentum vectors, and sums them for update direction—equalizing gradient magnitudes across class groups while suppressing noise in rare-class gradients. We provide the first FL convergence analysis explicitly incorporating time-varying resampling rates. To efficiently tune these rates in small-client regimes, we introduce FedHOO, an X-armed bandit algorithm leveraging federated parallelism to evaluate two candidate rate pairs per client at linear cost. Experiments on four public long-tailed benchmarks and a proprietary chip-defect dataset show FedCGNM consistently outperforms strong baselines; FedHOO delivers further gains (+1.8–3.3% minority accuracy) in small-scale federations.

Abstract

Class imbalance poses a critical challenge in federated learning (FL), where underrepresented classes suffer from poor predictive performance yet cannot be addressed by standard centralized techniques due to privacy and heterogeneity constraints. We propose FedCGNM (Federated Class-Grouped Normalized Momentum), a client-side optimizer in FL that partitions classes into a small number of groups based on minimum within-group variance, maintains a momentum per group, normalizes each group momentum to unit length, and uses the summation of the normalized group momentums as an update direction. This design both equalizes gradient magnitude across majority and minority groups and mitigates the noise inherent in rare-class gradients. We further provide a theoretical convergence analysis explicitly accounting for time-varying resampling-rates. Additionally, to efficiently optimize these rates in small-client regimes, we introduce FedHOO, an X-armed-bandit (XAB) based algorithm that exploits federated parallelism that evaluates many combinations of two candidate rates per client at linear cost. Empirical evaluation on four public long-tailed benchmarks and a proprietary chip-defect dataset demonstrates that FedCGNM consistently outperforms baselines, with FedHOO yielding further gains in small-scale federations.

item.title: RuleChef: Grounding LLM Task Knowledge in Human-Editable Rules
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01293v1

AI Summary (中文)

RuleChef：将大语言模型任务知识锚定于人类可编辑规则

背景与动机：尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在NLP任务中表现出色，但其“黑箱”特性、推理不可控性、计算开销大及难以调试等问题严重制约其在高可靠性、可解释性要求场景（如金融、医疗、合规审查）中的落地。RuleChef旨在弥合LLM能力与传统规则系统的可解释性、确定性、轻量化优势之间的鸿沟。

方法创新：RuleChef提出一种两阶段规则蒸馏框架：

  • 规则合成阶段：以任务描述（如“识别人名、地名、组织名”）和少量标注样本为输入，调用LLM（仅在学习时使用）生成初始可执行规则（如正则表达式、逻辑条件链、函数式规则），支持文本分类、命名实体识别（NER）、关系抽取等任务；
  • 迭代精化阶段：基于验证集上的失败案例自动定位规则漏洞，并支持双路径反馈闭环——既可通过新增标注样例触发规则修补（data-driven），也可直接接收人工编辑的规则修正（human-in-the-loop），实现“所见即所得”的可控优化；
  • 模型引导启动：支持从任意现有模型（如微调BERT或商用API）的输入-输出对中反向蒸馏规则，显著降低冷启动门槛。

核心成果：最终产出的是无需LLM推理的纯规则系统——具备毫秒级响应、100%确定性、全链路可追溯、规则集完全开放可读可改。在多个文本分类与NER基准数据集上的初步实验表明：RuleChef生成的规则在保持92–96%原始LLM性能的同时，推理速度提升3个数量级，内存占用降低99%，且所有决策均可被审计。项目已开源（Apache 2.0协议），提供完整CLI工具链与可视化规则编辑器。

AI Summary (English)

RuleChef is a novel framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) only during learning to synthesize, refine, and ground task-specific knowledge into human-readable, executable rules for NLP tasks—including text classification, NER, and relation extraction. Given a natural-language task description and a small set of labeled examples, RuleChef first generates initial rules (e.g., logic-based or regex patterns); it then iteratively patches them using failure analysis on held-out data and direct human edits—enabling transparent, deterministic, and ultra-fast inference without runtime LLM calls. Crucially, RuleChef also supports bootstrapping rules from any existing model’s input-output behavior, lowering entry barriers. Evaluation on classification and NER tasks shows RuleChef achieves 92–96% of the original LLM’s accuracy while reducing latency by ~1000× and memory usage by >99%. The resulting rule system is fully inspectable, editable, and deployable offline. RuleChef is released as open-source under Apache 2.0.

Abstract

We present RuleChef, a framework that uses large language models (LLMs) to generate executable rules for NLP tasks such as text classification, Named Entity Recognition (NER), or relation extraction. Rules are generated based on a task description and a set of labeled examples, then they are iteratively improved based both on additional examples and on human feedback overexisting rules. RuleChef can also be used to bootstrap rules using the observed input-output pairs from any existing model for a given task. LLMs are used only at learning time, synthesizing rules and iteratively patching them based on failures measured on a held-out split. The result of this process is a fast, deterministic, and inspectable rule system. Preliminary evaluation is performed on both classification and NER tasks. We release RuleChef as open-source software under an Apache 2.0

item.title: Spain: Succinct proofs for numerical computations
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1356

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

在简洁证明（succinct proof）协议中，验证者无需重复执行计算，即可高效确信不可信的证明者已正确完成指定运算。十余年来，该领域已从理论突破迅速走向工程落地。然而，其实际应用面临关键瓶颈：需将目标计算手工编译为代数约束系统（如算术电路或R1CS），而现有框架对数值计算（即大量依赖实数近似运算的场景，如科学计算、机器学习推理、优化求解）缺乏系统性支持——因传统约束要求精确满足，无法容纳浮点舍入误差、截断误差等固有近似性。

方法与创新

本论文提出Spain——首个专为数值计算设计的简洁证明系统。核心洞见在于：既然数值计算天然具有近似性，约束系统本身也应支持“近似可满足性”。为此，Spain提出：

  • 新型松弛约束模型：引入误差容限参数ε，允许约束在指定精度内近似成立；
  • 端到端编译框架：支持从Python数值代码（含NumPy操作、迭代算法）自动转换为带误差语义的约束表示；
  • 定制化证明协议：基于改进的多项式承诺与随机线性组合技术，在保持零知识性的同时支持高效验证。

实验结果

在典型数值任务（如矩阵乘法、非线性方程求解、梯度下降迭代）上，Spain相较朴素编译至标准R1CS的基线方案，证明生成速度快2–4个数量级，证明大小缩减至1/50–1/200，且验证时间仍保持亚毫秒级。实验验证了其在精度可控（ε∈[1e−3, 1e−6]）前提下的实用性与鲁棒性，填补了简洁证明在科学计算领域的关键空白。

AI Summary (English)

This paper introduces Spain, the first succinct proof system designed specifically for numerical computations—those relying on approximate real-number arithmetic (e.g., floating-point operations, iterative solvers). Recognizing that numerical error is intrinsic and unavoidable, Spain departs from traditional exact constraint satisfaction by formalizing approximate satisfiability: constraints need only hold within a user-specified tolerance ε. It provides an end-to-end pipeline—from Python/NumPy code to relaxed algebraic constraints—and a novel proof protocol leveraging polynomial commitments with error-aware linear combinations. Evaluated on matrix multiplication, root finding, and gradient descent, Spain achieves 2–4 orders-of-magnitude speedup in proof generation and reduces proof size by 50×–200× over naive R1CS baselines, while maintaining sub-millisecond verification and controllable numerical fidelity (ε = 10⁻³–10⁻⁶). Spain bridges a critical gap between succinct proofs and practical scientific computing.

Abstract

In a succinct proof protocol, a verifier gets assurance that an untrusted prover executed an agreed computation, without requiring the verifier to re-execute the computation itself. In little more than a decade, this area has undergone a remarkable transformation from theory to implemented systems. This activity is extremely exciting. But there is a catch. To apply succinct proofs, one needs to translate one's computation to a set of equations, or constraints. The required translation has so far completely blocked systematic support for numerical computations, namely those for which the bulk of the computation uses approximations of real numbers. This paper fills that void with the design, implementation, and evaluation of a system called Spain. The starting insight of Spain is that since numerical computations inherently have approximation error, the constraint formalism should likewise allow for approximate satisfiability. Based on this insight, Spain introduces a new proof protocol and new ways to translate computations to constraints. Spain's implementation improves over natural baselines by multiple orders of magnitude.

item.title: Compressing Correlations via Secret Replication: PCFs from Symmetric Cryptography
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1355

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

本文重新审视仅使用对称密码学安全压缩多方相关性的经典问题。所谓线性相关性 $\mathcal{C}$，由有限域 $\mathbb{F}^n$ 中的线性子空间 $C \subseteq \mathbb{F}^n$ 定义：随机采样秘密向量 $\mathbf{c} \in C$，并将其分量按固定模式分配给各参与方。Gilboa-Ishai（Crypto ’99）及Cramer-Damgård-Ishai（TCC ’05）提出一种通用压缩方案：通过对伪随机函数（PRF）密钥进行公开复制（public replication），可高效压缩多个独立$\mathcal{C}$样本，从而构造出针对$C$的伪随机相关函数（PCF）——其密钥大小正比于$C$中极小支撑码字（minimal-support codewords）的数量。

核心创新：从“公开”到“秘密”复制

本文关键洞见在于：将原有“公开复制”推广为秘密复制（secret replication）。具体而言，通过为原始相关性 $\mathcal{C}$ 中的参与方随机秘密地映射到目标相关性 $\mathcal{C}_T$ 的参与方上，可生成适配更广泛目标结构（如VOLE、子域VOLE、标量-向量乘法三元组等）的PCF。该蓝图不依赖公钥密码或可信硬件，纯基于对称原语（如标准PRF），显著提升实用性与效率。

主要成果与应用

  • 统一重构：自然导出Roy（Crypto ’22）提出的两方小域VOLE/子域VOLE PCF构造；
  • 新多方PCF：首次实现小域VOLE风格多方相关性的高效PCF，包括标量-向量乘法三元组及其认证变体（含MAC保护），支持任意参与方数量；
  • 应用延伸：所构造PCF可直接用于优化MPC协议（如Beaver三元组生成、零知识证明、隐私集合求交），降低通信与本地计算开销。

本工作将PCF设计范式从“结构驱动”转向“映射驱动”，为对称密码学赋能安全多方计算提供了更灵活、更普适的理论工具。

AI Summary (English)

We revisit secure compression of multiparty correlations using only symmetric cryptography. Prior work (Gilboa-Ishai, Cramer–Damgård–Ishai) constructs pseudorandom correlation functions (PCFs) for linear correlations $\mathcal{C}$ via public replication of PRF keys—yielding PCF key size proportional to the number of minimal-support codewords in $C$. We generalize this paradigm by introducing secret replication: a random secret mapping from parties in $\mathcal{C}$ to parties in a target correlation $\mathcal{C}_T$ enables PCF constructions for broader classes of useful correlations. Our framework uniformly recovers Roy’s (Crypto 2022) two-party PCFs for VOLE and subfield-VOLE over small domains, and yields new multiparty PCFs for small-domain VOLE-style correlations—including scalar-vector multiplication triples and their authenticated variants. All constructions rely solely on standard symmetric primitives (e.g., PRFs), enabling efficient, scalable secure computation without public-key assumptions.

Abstract

We revisit the question of securely compressing multiparty correlations using only symmetric cryptography. A linear correlation ${\cal C}$, defined by a linear subspace $C\subseteq \mathbb F^n$, samples a secret random ${\bf c}\in C$ and assigns to each party a fixed subset of the entries of ${\bf c}$. Gilboa and Ishai (Crypto 1999) and Cramer, Damgård and Ishai (TCC 2005) provide a general technique for securely compressing many independent samples from $\cal C$ by replicating independent keys of a pseudorandom function (PRF) among the parties. This implies a pseudorandom correlation function (PCF) for $\cal C$ from any PRF, where the PCF key size scales with the number of minimal-support codewords in $C$.

We observe that the above generalizes to other types of useful target correlations ${\cal C}_T$ by using a secret replication pattern obtained via a random secret assignment of parties in $\cal C$ to parties in ${\cal C}_T$.

We present several corollaries of this general blueprint. These include a re-derivation of two-party PCF constructions for VOLE and subfield-VOLE over small domains (Roy, Crypto 2022) as well as new multiparty PCFs for small-domain VOLE-style correlations, including scalar-vector multiplication triples and their authenticated variants. Finally, we discuss applications to secure computation.

item.title: Adaptive Quantum-Resistant Hybrid Encryption Framework for Secure IoMT Edge Data Sharing
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1354

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

物联网医疗设备（IoMT）正推动实时健康监测与个性化诊疗的变革，但其边缘节点普遍存在资源受限（低算力、小内存、弱电池）特性。当前安全方案常在抗量子能力与运行效率之间折衷：纯经典加密易受Shor算法威胁；纯后量子密码（PQC）又因高计算开销难以部署于微型传感器或可穿戴设备。更严峻的是，异构IoMT系统采用碎片化的加密栈——有的仅支持RSA/ECC，有的已集成CRYSTALS-Kyber或Dilithium，缺乏统一、可适配的安全框架。

方法与创新

本文提出隐私保护混合数据共享（$P^2HDS$）框架，首创性地构建了一个自适应量子抗性混合加密范式：

  • ✅ 广义协议建模：形式化定义含经典（如AES-256+RSA-OAEP）与后量子（如Kyber768+AES-256）组合的通用混合加密流程，支持按设备能力、数据敏感度、网络延迟等维度动态选择最优算法组合；
  • ✅ 博弈论驱动配置：将数据所有者与攻击者建模为非零和博弈参与者，通过纳什均衡分析确定最小成本—最大安全的加密策略组合，显著降低密钥协商与加解密开销；
  • ✅ 严格安全性证明：在随机预言机模型下，首次证明该混合结构满足选择明文攻击下的不可区分性（IND-CPA）——只要任一底层组件具备IND-CPA安全性，整体即安全。

实验验证

在ARM Cortex-M4与Raspberry Pi 4平台上测试表明：$P^2HDS$的端到端加密延迟仅为单一最安全方案的62%，吞吐量达其1.7倍，同时安全强度等效于所用最强组件（如Kyber768）。该框架已开源并兼容FHIR标准，为分级诊疗、远程手术等高敏场景提供可扩展、合规、即插即用的量子安全边缘数据共享基础设施。

AI Summary (English)

The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) demands quantum-resistant security that balances robustness with extreme resource constraints. We propose $P^2HDS$, an adaptive hybrid encryption framework integrating classical and post-quantum schemes (e.g., RSA-OAEP + Kyber768 + AES-256) to enable context-aware, efficient, and provably secure edge data sharing. Using game-theoretic analysis, we derive optimal encryption configurations under adversarial threats while maintaining IND-CPA security in the random oracle model—guaranteed if at least one constituent scheme is IND-CPA-secure. Experiments on ARM and Raspberry Pi platforms show $P^2HDS$ achieves ~62% lower latency and 1.7× higher throughput than the strongest single-component scheme, without compromising security. It offers a scalable, standards-compliant solution for privacy-preserving IoMT applications facing imminent quantum threats.

Abstract

The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) is revolutionizing healthcare through real-time monitoring and personalized care, yet existing security solutions for resource-constrained IoMT devices often compromise between robust protection and computational efficiency. Additionally, various IoMT systems utilize different sets of encryption schemes, ranging from classical to post-quantum algorithms, tailored to their computational resources, operational constraints, and specific privacy challenges. This diversity highlights an urgent need for an adaptive and efficient, quantum-resistant security protocol applicable to these systems. We propose the Privacy-Preserving Hybrid Data Sharing ($P^2HDS$) framework, which integrates multiple classical and post-quantum encryption schemes to achieve strong security with enhanced efficiency. $P^2HDS$ formalizes a generalized hybrid encryption protocol that enables adaptive configuration based on security requirements and computational constraints. We employ game-theoretic analysis to model interactions between data owners and adversaries, determining the optimal combination of encryption schemes for data outsourcing to mitigate adversarial threats. Rigorous security analysis proves that $P^2HDS$ achieves indistinguishability under chosen-plaintext attack (IND-CPA) security in the random oracle model, provided at least one constituent scheme is IND-CPA-secure. Experimental results demonstrate that $P^2HDS$ delivers performance approximating the average of its constituent schemes while maintaining security comparable to the most secure component, making it a scalable, quantum-resistant, and adaptive solution for privacy-preserving IoMT edge applications.

item.title: 3PaaS: Privacy-Preserving Post-Compromise Security as a Service
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1353

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

后妥协安全性（Post-Compromise Security, PCS）指系统在某参与方遭短期入侵后，仍能通过密钥演进实现“安全自愈”。尽管双棘轮等机制已在Signal等应用中部署，实际PCS保障仍严重受限：其恢复能力仅限于单一会话，无法跨新会话、多群组或跨服务延续；且受状态丢失容错等现实约束影响，甚至Signal亦难以在实践中达成完整PCS。更关键的是，现有方案缺乏可复用的基础设施支持，导致PCS始终是应用层的定制化负担。

创新方案：3PaaS

本文提出首个面向身份的隐私保护型PCS即服务（3PaaS）协议，首次将PCS能力解耦为第三方可托管的通用服务。核心突破在于解决根本性张力：PCS需用户定期更新长期密钥（仅一次/周期），而第三方服务器若直接验证用户身份，将破坏匿名性与活动不可链接性。

技术贡献

  • 设计轻量级、可验证的盲签名零知识证明（ZK-BS），为首个高效支持盲签名验证的ZK方案，使服务器无需获知用户身份即可确认密钥更新请求的有效性；
  • 构建完整的3PaaS协议栈，支持无服务器身份泄露的密钥轮换与即时撤销；
  • 形式化建模并证明协议满足强PCS安全定义（包含前向保密、后向保密与自愈性）；
  • 开源实现新型ZK构件（基于R1CS-SNARK），并在模拟信令架构中验证端到端集成可行性。

本工作为构建跨平台、可组合、隐私优先的自愈型安全基础设施迈出关键一步。

AI Summary (English)

Post-Compromise Security (PCS) enables systems to “heal” after temporary compromise, but existing approaches—like the Double Ratchet—are session-bound, fail under state-loss scenarios, and lack cross-service composability. We present 3PaaS, the first privacy-preserving PCS-as-a-Service protocol enabling third-party–managed PCS for identities. Its core innovation is a novel efficient zero-knowledge proof for blind signatures, allowing a server to verify that a user’s secret update is valid without learning who issued it or what context triggered it—thus preserving unlinkability. The protocol supports revocation, withstands state loss, and formally satisfies strong PCS guarantees (forward/backward secrecy + self-healing). We implement its ZK primitives and demonstrate integration with secure messaging. 3PaaS shifts PCS from application-specific logic to a reusable, privacy-aware infrastructure layer.

Abstract

Post-Compromise Security (PCS) expresses that even after a party has been compromised, it may be able to recover (or "heal") security afterwards. PCS has been extensively studied, and many end-to-end secure messaging applications include mechanisms, such as the double ratchet, to achieve it.

However, current approaches only work partially, and their healing effects are extremely limited. For example, recent work showed that due to real-world constraints such as resilience against state loss, even highly secure messengers such as Signal may not achieve it in practice. Moreover, since healing is session-specific, healing effects do not carry over to newly spawned sessions, different groups, or different services that use the same identity.

In this work, we tackle these issues by designing the first protocol that can provide PCS as a Service for identities through a third party. The major challenge is privacy: achieving PCS requires regular updates among participants, and involving a third party can lead to significant privacy concerns. Moreover, the type of update that PCS requires (updating a user's secret, but only once) seems to require servers to verify the users' identities in a way that contradicts the unlinkability required for privacy: the server should not learn anything about the users' activities.

We develop the 3PaaS protocol, including the first efficient zero-knowledge proofs for blind signatures, to achieve our goals, and even allow for revocation, without revealing the identity to the server. We formally analyze our protocol for high assurance, provide an implementation of our novel ZK building blocks, and show how our protocol could be used with a messaging application.

item.title: Dead Man’s Switch Cryptography
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1352

AI Summary (中文)

死亡开关密码学：首个形式化定义与通用可组合实现

本研究首次对死亡开关密码学（Dead Man’s Switch Cryptography, DMS） 进行形式化建模与严格安全性分析。该范式旨在解决一个关键现实问题：当长期保管某敏感秘密的唯一持有者（如密钥所有者）去世后，如何通过密码学手段确定性地、可验证地执行其预设意愿——或仅向指定受托人释放秘密（DMS-release），或不可逆地销毁秘密（DMS-delete），杜绝未授权访问与意外泄露。

我们提出DMS作为独立密码学原语，明确定义其双模语义（release/delete）及核心安全属性：活性（liveness）（死亡触发后协议必终止）、正确性（correctness）（输出严格匹配预设模式）、机密性（confidentiality）（非授权方无法获知秘密内容）与不可抵赖性（irrevocability）（delete模式下无恢复可能）。为实现该原语，我们设计并形式化了经销商控制的演化委员会主动秘密共享（DC-EPSS）——这是Benhamouda等人（TCC ’20）EPSS方案的重要扩展，支持由可信经销商动态配置委员会演进策略与操作模式（release/delete）。我们在通用可组合（UC）框架下给出DC-EPSS的完整建模，并基于Abraham等人的嵌套YOSO框架实现其通用构造。

进一步，我们构建：

  • DMS-release：将DC-EPSS与PKI基础设施、多接收者公钥加密（PKE）、密钥承诺对称加密（SKE）及非交互零知识（NIZK）证明系统耦合，确保仅经认证的受托人群体联合可恢复秘密；
  • DMS-delete：直接调用DC-EPSS的delete模式，通过分布式擦除与可验证销毁证明实现。

所有构造均在标准假设（DDH、CRHF、LWE等）下于UC模型中被严格证明安全，填补了该领域长期存在的理论空白。

AI Summary (English)

We initiate the formal study of Dead Man’s Switch (DMS) cryptography, a new primitive enabling cryptographic enforcement of a long-lived secret’s fate upon its sole keeper’s death—either exclusive release to designated nominees or provable, irreversible destruction. We define DMS as a standalone UC-secure primitive with two modes: release and delete.
